rows.short_description: ARENA OF KINGS is a fast-paced team arena brawler. Experience MMORPG-style combat without the grind. Create a hero from 10 unique classes. Level up, learn new spells, and collect epic loot. Casual, Ranked, and Tournament game modes. PLAY FOR FREE!
rows.description_html: COMMUNITY About the Game Experience MMORPG-style arena PvP in its purest form . Create your hero, customize your spells, and jump straight into 3v3 arena battles in a fight to the death! With no barrier to entry, there's nothing stopping you and your friends from joining our world. Play for FREE! 'The ultimate Esport game of raw skill, lightning-fast pace, teamwork, and strategy.' - Iverson, Bloodline Champions DreamHack World Champion ALL 10 CLASSES FREE Freedom of choice is a core pillar in our design. As a player, become empowered by the meaningful choices you make when theorycrafting your build. With over 150+ Spells available and only 8 fitting on your Spell Bar at a time, discover limitless combinations that directly impact the course of battle. BRING FRIENDS AND PARTY UP Solo Queue or Flex Queue in teams of 3 players. Precisely calibrated Skill-based Matchmaking ensures that you'll be matched against the right opponents every game. ASCENSION GAME MODE To the victor go the spoils! Consecutive victories increases your group's Bounty Value , advancing your party closer towards King's Ascent , a Continuous Global Tournament Event reserved for the two most dominant teams. Winning Ascension rewards epic treasure and a global shoutout heard across the Arena of Kings universe. FREQUENT GAME UPDATES We are dedicated to maintaining a healthy state of the game. Consistent game updates bring us closer to a more perfect state of balance. Seasonal content patches introduce new classes, spells, arenas, items, and fresh leaderboards to climb! FLUID MOVEMENT & OPTIMIZED NETCODE Lag ruins gaming . Our commitment to a smooth player experience experience is paramount. Experience instantly responsive movement , performance optimized high-tick servers , and gameplay fluidity that has been heavily QA tested with arena veterans. JOIN THE ARENA COMMUNITY!

rows.name: Lostria
rows.short_description: - BETA VERSION - Lostria is an online turn-based tactical game in a fantasy universe. Players build teams and compete among themself in tactical battles to become the best strategist in the world.
rows.description_html: Lostria is a competitive turn-based game set in the fantasy universe of the same name. Beta version The game is still in development and we plan to complete it before the end of the year. In the meantime yon can alredy play on the beta and playtest versions! Gameplay Build your team and compete against other players in Ranked or Friendly matches. Get rewards, unlock new characters and build even more specialized teams to lead you to victory. For the more creative ones, the map editor is at your disposal, show your artist and level designer skills to your friends. Come challenge players around the world and try to become the best strategist!

rows.name: LAST CLOUDIA
rows.short_description: A fantasy RPG that weaves a sprawling tale with quirky characters and cinematic effects. Its gorgeous, fast-paced battles feature pixel art characters sweeping though 3D playspaces.
rows.description_html: Cinematic Effects and Sweeping Soundtrack A riveting tale told with pixel-art characters and 3D backgrounds, brought to life with lovingly crafted music and animation! White-knuckle Combat Action Heart-pounding real-time combat at a speed that's only possible with pixel art! Deep Character-building System Go beyond collecting strong characters—train your favorite characters to have the stats you want! It's all up to you! Hands-free autoplay No need to grind manually—just gear up your team and send them out to collect power-up materials! Star-studded Cast Of Voice actors Famous Japanese voice actors provide dynamic voices for characters in battle, when powering up, on the Home screen, and more! —story— Welcome to Granzelia, where people live among magical beasts. Long ago this world was tyrannically ruled by the God of Ruin, until the hero Adel and goddess Lilaha joined forces to seal it away. In the centuries since then, that hero's bloodline built the Aldana Empire to peacefully rule all the land—but lately changes are afoot. As reports of strange beast attacks surge, the 12th Order knight Kyle and the magical beast Rei set out on a mission. Neither knows it's the start of an epic battle that will shake the world! Swords, Sorcery, and Scintillating Combat! The Rpg Last Cloudia Has It All!

rows.name: OneBit Adventure
rows.short_description: OneBit Adventure is a casual turn-based roguelike where you adventure as far as possible to level up and battle against rogue monsters. Your primary goal in OneBit Adventure is to survive and loot. Choose from a variety of classes and build the ultimate class.
rows.description_html: OneBit Adventure is a casual turn-based roguelike where your adventure is a never-ending travel against rogue monsters. The further you go, the more difficult monsters will become, but the greater the loot and experience. Choose from a variety of classes and build the ultimate class, but be wary, OneBit is a very dangerous place full of untold mysteries. Explore various dungeons to loot and ascend your character to survive even longer! Your movement is your main action which can go 4 directions. Attack enemies by bumping into them and constantly moving that direction to attack. Collect coins to buy various items and once your level 15, you will be able to buy new skills from Wizard Sapius. Use these skills to help you battle through tougher foes and survive longer in your travels. Play as a Warrior, Blood knight, Wizard, Necromancer, Pyromancer, Archer or Thief. Each character has its own unique play style, abilities, and weakness. Unlock their true potential by leveling up which opens the world of active and passive skills that make every class unique. Complete various adventure quests and you can ascend your character to the next level. Prestige at level 100 and you will restart at level 1, but with permanently more skillpoints and more bonus XP. OneBit Adventure is a casual roguelike meaning the game is simple to play, but can be challenging the further you go. You have a limited amount of health and if your health reaches 0, its game over. Classic mode allows you to resurrect to continue while hardcore mode provides the ultimate permadeath experience and harder enemies to fight. The end of an adventure is a new beginning as completed adventures are submitted to Rankings where you can challenge your skills against thousands of others between steps traveled, kills and coins collected with Classic and Hardcore mode! OneBit Adventure is also available on Google Play and App Store with cross-sync compatibility! You can play on Steam and on mobile devices with 1 account. Simply load your account with your username and cloud ID and you are ready to switch between them seamlessly! Change the way OneBit Adventure looks completely with unlockable themes that makes the game fit to your liking. If you love 8-bit roguelikes and are looking for something casual to play, then you should consider OneBit Adventure right now. It's meant to be a simply fun experience where you can level up, play around with different combinations of weapons and skills to reach the furthest. It's a relaxing game, but also has leaderboards to compete with other OneBit players around the world! Features • Infinite world generation with 4+ unique dungeons • 6+ bosses to battle • 7+ classes with unique character builds at level 15 • 30+ unique equipment to use • 40+ monsters to battle • Competitive worldwide leaderboard with premium rewards • Cross platform with Android, iOS, and Steam • Hardcore mode for true roguelike experience

This kinetic novel will take you about 40 minutes, making it a good way to pass the time if you're short on it.

rows.name: Battlegrounds : First Blast
rows.short_description: A military styled action tower-defense game filled with nukes, missiles and tanks. Improve your building, canons and tanks. Purchase stronger ammunition and survive the next wave. Highly replayable, tough and addictive. The fun never ends
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Battlegrounds takes the best part of roguelites, tower-defense, strategy and action genres and fuses them to create an enticing gameplay experience with easy to understand mechanics. The player must defend his home base from enemy tanks by quickly brainstorming good strategies, unlocking and upgrading machines and making the best use of every new environment present. Highly Replayable Awesome soundtracks Unlock and upgrade special vehicles Explore various strategies and playstyles Unlock achievements

rows.name: All Dream Long A Flower Storm
rows.short_description: Award-winning point-and-click game FREE to download and play! Relax into a dreamscape full of fairytales, legends, and peculiar scenery. With the help of friendly demon Baku, solve riddles and puzzles to reach the true end and wake up... if you want to wake up, that is.
rows.description_html: A whimsical, award-winning point-and-click visual novel adventure game from the creators of HUNGRY TEA PARTY and My Dear Frankenstein. Relax into a dreamscape alongside a friendly, hungry demon called Baku. Explore a world made of fairytales, traditional Japanese legends, classic Western literature, and peculiar scenery where real-life physics doesn't apply. Solve riddles and puzzles to help colorful characters, some human, some not. But be warned... the further you go into your dream, the less you may want to wake up. Play time: About 2 hours Endings: 4 (three normal, one true end) Release date (in Japanese): March 25, 2019 (in Korean): April 23, 2020 (in English): August 20, 2021 Made with: Tyranobuilder and Tyranoscript Silver Prize winner in the Tyrano Game Festival 2019.

rows.name: Spirit of Europe - Origins
rows.short_description: An edutainment jRPG experience, spanning from ancient Greece to the 12th century European Renaissance, brimming with historically-accurate characters and events, experienced through two realms: of spirits, thoughts and emotions, and the material world.
rows.description_html: The Spirit of Europe - Origins is a free edutainment jRPG independent game, developed in Unreal Engine 4. Embody a fragment of the mythical Europa and travel through history from the ancient times to the Renaissance, through the realm of thoughts and emotions, where spirits fight for supremacy over human consciousness. Experience a humanistic metaphor of historical events as we know them, possess over a hundred characters, drive their actions and witness their consequences in pivotal events of Europe’s past. Warning We would like to underline that this product is an indie effort, so please set your expectations accordingly. Features : ● Free; ● Historically accurate educational content; ● Two realms: the spirit realm and the material one; ● Possession system, allowing you to take control of any NPC; ● Economy and building system used to upgrade and recruit units; ● Disciples II-inspired, tactical, turn-based combat; ● A deeply philosophical, fictional story-line involving gods, virtues, vices, concepts and thoughts, manifested as spirits; ● Over 15 hours of gameplay; ● 58 combat units with over 50 unique abilities; ● Over 240 NPCs to interact with, from ancient Greece to the 12th century European Renaissance; ● 13 unique maps offering over 20 quests; ● Possess & explore the world with over 240 characters, from mere commoners to great figures of European history. Experience history with a twist : The perspectives of Gods, personalized virtues and vices are different from those of mere mortals in the spirit world we’ve built inspired by archetypal stories, western philosophy and core principles which the modern western society is built on: peace, democracy, rule of law, freedom, tolerance, pluralism - and we’ll let you discover the rest. Discover the forging of Europe & the birth of the western ethos : Possess any mortal, be it a mere commoner or a great figure of history. Drive their actions and learn about their way of life, beliefs, fears and hopes, aspirations and ambition - and you may be surprised at what you uncover. Assemble your troops & manage your resources : Gain influence with the living and inspire them to build the great edifices we know today. Gather the souls of defeated vices and use them to summon allies from among those fallen throughout the ages. Augment them with godly essences for they will be your shield against the forces that seek your undoing - and you will witness how the bitterest foes can become allies. By your hand shall history be made : Be the invisible hand that forges Europe’s history as we know it: from the ancient times of Classical Greece, throughout the glory of the Roman Empire, the tumult of its fall, the chaos that followed and the bonds formed in the Middle Ages. Your journey through Europe will only end once it’s reborn - or will it?

rows.name: Your Adventure
rows.short_description: Create a custom character, and be whoever you want to be! Enjoy traversing strange worlds, and mastering action command combat as you fight strange and odd and weird enemies and bosses! Remember, this is your adventure!
rows.description_html: This demo and listing are old! If you're looking to play the new and improved demo for TeleCollision, with new features, level designs, puzzles, and story elements, check out and play that demo! It has much more content than this Your Adventure demo! Create a custom character, and be whoever you want to be! A space princess? A mighty warrior? An office drone? A half angel half demon jousting champion? Then set off on Your Adventure, in one of three genres! A medieval realm of dark mysteries, a space station in deep space with roguish characters, and a school for the supernaturally gifted. Will you save the trinity of realities? Stop the murder on the space express? Fall in love with the dreamy supernatural entity? Or reality hop and enjoy a variety of different experiences? Enjoy traversing strange worlds, making friends, and mastering action command combat as you fight strange and odd and weird enemies and bosses! Remember, this is your adventure! Features: Character Customization Custom pronouns, don't worry about picking a gender Each of the three genres is a unique level Customize your play style with different equipment loads A few music tracks made by the guy who made everything else, who doesn't know how to write music Lots of music tracks made by someone else who does know how to write music Large words used usually improperly A tiny cowboy just trying to get ahead in life Reality Television Lots of jokes you might find endearing

rows.name: 13:ORIGIN - Prologue
rows.short_description: 13: Origin is a web of clues that you must follow and not miss, as in most room escape/puzzle games. As you untie each knotted loop, you will realize how long and endless the thread you hold on to the end is.
rows.description_html: When you wake up in the mental institute you're in charge of, you realize you've been locked in your room by your most dangerous (and clever) patient. Will you be able to reach the way out while taking the journal you found in your room and stepping into an ancient story? 13:Origin - Prologue is a kind of preview of our game called '13:Origin' , which we aim to release soon. With this prologue, you will be able to experience the storyline we aim for and some of our different, unique and satisfying puzzles. 13:Origin offers you more than just a mechanical puzzle-solving experience. You'll need to leverage the mechanics, the story, your instincts, and most importantly, 'doubt' to solve puzzles meticulously crafted for you. IMERSIVE AND ORGANIC STORY 13:Origin - Prologue offers you a unique story that you have not experienced before and the tense atmosphere created by that story. SECRETS TO DISCOVER As you solve these unique puzzles, you also uncover a secret that has been around since the beginning of mankind. MINIMALIST INTERFACE We do not want to confuse your mind even more, which is already sufficiently entangled with stories and puzzles. The interface and gameplay were thought as minimalist as possible.

rows.name: 20b
rows.short_description: Eight peculiar students, a pair of highly-trained assassins, extraterrestrials plotting a full-scale invasion of Earth, a secret society on the verge of toppling the US presidency and a Doomsday cult gearing to wipe California off the map.
rows.description_html: Description: Unlike her parents, all Sookie’s ever wanted is to live a normal and quiet life . She isn’t interested in getting wrapped up in other people’s business and instead chooses to live life as a background character. As just another cog in the machine. Unseen and unheard. Unfortunately for her, she’s plagued with bad luck . Outside of getting into a whole host of colorful, cartoon-like accidents, Sookie’s poor luck manifests itself in scenarios that thrust her into the limelight, actively working against her goal of being on the sidelines of life. So much so that upon arriving at her new and mysterious school, Sookie is offered an ultimatum by the Principal. “Defeat the seven MISFITS or face expulsion” What started out with Sookie wanting to live peacefully ends up devolving into utter pandemonium. Amongst the madness of this hour-long, globe-trotting visual novel, will our poor protagonist ever catch a break? Features: Free Short, kinetic visual novel with a unique structure and blistering pace From New York to Paris, to Cairo and Rome... Live a life as you travel across the world and battle your new classmates Mingle with a cast of dozens! From the strange and zany to the cryptic and unknown as you try to get away from it all Original soundtrack ...and more!

rows.name: Yearning: A Gay Story
rows.short_description: Yearning: A Gay Story (YAGS) is a realistic coming-out-focused character-driven slice-of-life visual novel where you play as a gay man starting his freshman year of college at a generic university somewhere in the midwestern United States.
rows.description_html: Yearning: A Gay Story (YAGS for short) is a realistic coming-out-focused character-driven slice-of-life visual novel where you play as a gay man starting his freshman year of college at a generic university somewhere in the midwestern United States. The game features dating sim elements, but is not focused on them. You will interact with a cast of characters, each with their own personality and stories, as you navigate college life, develop friendships, play board games, and come out. With luck, you might even find a boyfriend. A world where you can befriend people and see events from different perspectives, depending on your decisions 4 dateable guys* with their own distinct stories, with good and bad endings for each guy (9 endings in all*) 230,000+ words and meaningful choices Collectibles system to track and reward your decisions Achievements, for completionists Unlockable in-game character profiles An original soundtrack featuring 'Yearning', the YAGS theme * Or are there? rows.name: Idle Monkeylogy
rows.short_description: IDLE GAME based on the Infinite Monkey Theorem
rows.description_html: VERY ECCENTRIC IDLE GAME HERE! Idle Monkeylogy is a clicker-idle game that is based on The infinite monkey theorem in which a monkey infinitely types the keyboard randomly to complete Shakespeare's work. Features Type as monkeys do! You have to type randomly to complete the word! And later, you will be able to make the monkeys type! Fruits Gathering As monkeys type they get hungry. Shake the tree to get some apples! You need enormous amount of apples for typing a lot. Upgrades Various upgrade for monkeys for better income! Later, it will also make monkeys type automatically so let's get more and more words! [Making a dictionary] You can make a dictionary made of words you and monkeys completed! [Ascending] You start the game from beginning with a lot of new upgrades! [Challenge] Make your monkeys grow and challenge the sentences with too many letters! Try how strong your monkeys are! Controls You can play all the contents with only a mouse click, but there are some hotkeys for this game. - 'Any key' to type randomly - 'Space' to go ahead a next word - Hold down the upgrade button to buy it continuously!

rows.name: Incremental Epic Hero 2
rows.short_description: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!
rows.description_html: Incremental Epic Hero 2 (IEH2) is the sequel to the original Incremental Epic Hero . Don’t worry if you haven’t played the first game—you can fully enjoy this one without any prior experience! This game is an Incremental/Idle RPG crafted by a Japanese developer. After 2.5 years of Early Access (beta), we are thrilled to announce its full release! With countless updates based on feedback and ideas from our players, this game has been polished to its current state. We hope you enjoy it! Explore the World of IEH2! In IEH2, you control six unique heroes as they adventure through a vast fantasy world. With over 1,000 hours of gameplay content, the journey never truly ends. Dive in and explore the immersive world of IEH2 at your own pace—it’s a game designed to grow with you. Automated Battles Your heroes automatically move, attack, heal, and perform other actions, ensuring nonstop battles! By progressing through Rebirth , you can eventually manage all heroes simultaneously in the background. With over 100 unique monsters, 200+ pieces of equipment and items, and countless quests to complete, an exciting journey awaits! A Vast World Map The expansive world of IEH2 is filled with colorful monsters, including slimes, bats, unicorns, and more. Each area and dungeon features prestige mechanics, keeping your adventures fresh and exciting, no matter how many times you revisit them. Town Building Build various structures like the 'Statue of Heroes,' 'Cartographer,' and 'Alchemist's Hut' to upgrade your game’s functions. Design and grow your own personalized town! Rich Gameplay Elements Share unique skills among your six heroes to create dynamic strategies. Capture over 100 monsters and enhance their abilities through leveling up to strengthen your team. Brew dozens of potions through alchemy and empower your gear endlessly with enchanting scrolls. Collect, enhance, and refine over 200 pieces of equipment and items to bolster your heroes’ power. Rebirth your heroes to gain powerful progression boosts, starting fresh but stronger each time. Prestige the entire world through Ascension , unlocking even more content and stronger boosts. Challenge yourself with brand-new, high-stakes battle modes. Connect with the Developer! We actively incorporate feedback from players through our Discord community. The developer is Japanese, so feel free to reach out in Japanese! (Developer account name: Hitan )

rows.name: Incremental Cubes
rows.short_description: Cube based incremental game that is simple but very deep!
rows.description_html: This is a simple but very deep incremental game! All you need is to collect more cubes and keep going! 〇Overview Collect cubes, defeat enemies, and advance through the tiers. 〇Simple Upgrades Each cube has an upgrade that reduces the interval at which the cubes fall. 〇Prestige Prestige will reset all your progress, but it boosts the progress dramatically. You can buy a lot of skills from a 3D-like skill tree! The skill points needed to buy skills can be gained by attacking enemies. 〇Helpers As you progress through the game, helpers who will attack enemies and collect cubes for you will appear. 〇Boss Battle As you progress through the game, bosses will appear periodically. Bosses are hard to beat, but when you beat them, your current cube will change into a larger one. In addition, you can earn more skill points than usual. 〇Challenge Challenge mode will be unlocked as you progress through the game. Clearing challenges will give you super bonuses that will help you advance in the game. 〇Controls Mouse only.

Incredible experience: Could you imagine being able to order a pizza? With us, you will have a unique experience of ordering and waiting. Do not miss your chance! Features that you can see here: Quest like tasks (search/bring/combine items) Horror like tasks (there are some enemies who will lurk around you and try to kill you) Platformer like tasks (there are some tasks for running and fighting with some creatures)

rows.name: Maximum Football
rows.short_description: Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Recruit the next college superstar and take them into the pros to become a future Hall of Famer. Build your team with unparalleled in-game customization that gives you ultimate control.
rows.description_html: 2 Leagues. 1 Universe. Your Terms. Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Fully customize your team and build your dream roster to play solo or take it to the gridiron in local or online multiplayer. In Maximum Football, you have ultimate control over football simulation. FOOTBALL ON YOUR TERMS Don't just play the game, build it. Maximum Football’s deep customization suite gives you the power to create a unique identity. Craft the perfect helmet and jersey combination, use custom logos, and edit every detail of your roster to dominate the competition. Modify every piece of your football universe the way you want it, from league sizes to the rulesets. BUILD A COLLEGE DYNASTY In Dynasty Mode, you'll take the reins as head coach, scouring the nation for top recruits, developing their talent, and making the strategic decisions that lead to championships. You also take on the responsibilities of your school’s Athletic Director, where you upgrade and manage your stadium and facilities, as well as every detail of your school. This is a deep, multi-season experience for any college football fanatic. RUN A PRO FRANCHISE Try your hand at managing a pro team by building your roster from free agency and the draft, running the front office and stadium amenities, and making the game-time decisions to cement your franchise into a league leader. Connect Dynasty Mode with Franchise Mode to build one football universe, where you can draft your college superstars onto your pro roster. AUTHENTIC FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY Powered by the Unreal Engine 5, every snap is brought to life with our physics-based gameplay system. Feel the weight of every collision and experience the freedom of realistic player animations. This is football where your skill on the sticks truly matters. Play today for free!

rows.name: The Market of Light
rows.short_description: A short game and tech demo created with Unreal Engine 5. The player is a small firefly that collects orbs of light scattered around the market. Experience a meticulously rendered world from a micro view point!
rows.description_html: Notice - 09/29/2021 The game will launch at the resolution set on your PC. If the resolution is set to higher than full HD and the frame rate gets too low, you can try either of the following methods to lock the resolution to full HD. -At the title screen, follow the guide at the bottom right and enter the F key. -In the exit menu, follow the guide at the bottom right and enter the F key. This is a short game and tech demo created with the early access build of Unreal Engine 5. The player is a firefly that collects orbs of light scattered around the market. Play time: 15 - 30 minutes A small-town marketplace seems huge from the perspective of a tiny firefly. Experience a meticulously rendered world from a micro view point! Inspired by the excitement of the announcement by Unreal Engine 5, we created this game. 'Nanite' handles unlimited polygons, 'Lumen', which allows for perfectly dynamic lighting, and the latest visual effect tool, 'Niagara'. Even one would have been sensational, but it's a major event to have all of them come out at almost the same time. Tech Demo Highlights Super close-up presentation Dynamic sunlight changes Progressive visual effects -Film-quality assets can be used with almost no modification The 3 colors of light represent Nanite, Lumen, and Niagara. This game features next-generation representations of these new functions. We live in an interesting time, a turning point of technology, enjoy it with us!

rows.name: Monster Wilds
rows.short_description: Play as Doppel, the adorable shapeshifting blob, and battle your way through the Monster Wilds to become the ultimate Monster! Fight all kinds of unique enemies and explore a number of strikingly designed levels. DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A STUDENT GAME.
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A STUDENT GAME, PLAYERS ARE BOUND TO ENCOUNTER SOME BUGS AND ISSUES DURING GAMEPLAY. In the Monster Wilds, there is a hierarchy. The largest, most powerful monsters rule the largest swaths of territory, leaving less powerful monsters to the Wild Woods and surrounding areas. Where does that leave Doppels? Hiding, praying they’ll be able to eat and live. The player is one such doppel, a rare color among other blue doppels; one of those parasites who subsists off of monster carcasses and monsters big enough not to notice the stab of their horn. One day, the pink Doppel notices that if they stab right into the spinal cord under the monster cranium, they see flashes of the monster’s anatomy, and gain more than an understanding of their abilities; the player gains the ability itself. Others of its species simply survive; the player starts to realize that this constraint on their species could evaporate if Doppel were to teach them. The Doppel ventures forth, taking down small prey and learning abilities that will aid the whole of the Doppel species. When he returns, other doppels herald him a pioneer of another way of life—a hero. With the rising number of monsters that Doppel conquers, he begins to realize that he can combine abilities of monsters of similar level to become stronger. With each ability harvested, the doppel species becomes less and less afraid of the Wilds, and more lustful for adventure, with the pink Doppel at the helm of their expeditions. Doppel only wants to go farther; if it can only take on bigger monsters, it could become more powerful. And with power, comes respect. No longer will the player or their species be bottom-feeding parasites. They are ready to thrive. Play as Doppel, and battle your way through the Monster Wilds to become the ultimate Monster!

rows.name: Wolf At Evergreen
rows.short_description: **A Research Demo from 2021** A supernatural-mystery, interactive-narrative VR experience. Are the rumours of a werewolf sighting true? Talk with townspeople and explore the museum to discover what's truly happening in the small town of Evergreen.
rows.description_html: ** A Research-Based VR Demo from 2021 ** This VR experience was made as a part of the research component of a Master's degree for Rebecca Kerr with special thanks given to Curtin University and the talented voice actors who helped bring the characters to life. The initial release was submitted as part of the degree, with subsequential updates to improve user interactions and any bugs. ****** Please Note: As of July 14, 2022, this demo has received its final update and will not receive further updates. It remains available for all to enjoy in its current state. A big thank you to all those who supported this project! ****** ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE Wolf At Evergreen (originally Unnatural Freaks) is a VR interactive narrative experience, where you play as Frankie, an investigator who's a part of an online vlog series. Frankie’s role is to investigate rumours of supernatural/paranormal experiences to determine their truth and then make a video log about it. In this demo, Frankie investigates several werewolf sightings in the small town of Evergreen. By talking with the townspeople and exploring the museum, clues will emerge.

rows.name: Dungeon Overseer
rows.short_description: Dungeon Overseer is a colony simulator with a focus on base building and resource management. Become the Overseer by building a unique dungeon layout, constructing your lair, upgrading and expanding, questing, crafting, researching, recruiting, defending your base, and raiding.
rows.description_html: Join The Community! Power Pals! About the Game Become the Overseer! Dungeon Overseer is a colony simulator with a focus on base building and resource management. Dungeon Overseer looks to combine the fun elements of games like Dungeon Overlord and Fallout Shelter. Don the crown and pursue glory by building a unique dungeon layout, constructing your lair, upgrading and expanding your creation, questing, crafting, researching, recruiting, defending your base, and raiding. Build a resource production pool that will sustain your minion army. Level up your rooms and your minions. Become the Overseer and let everyone witness your true power! rows.name: Dash Realm
rows.short_description: Dash Realm is a 2D multiplayer top down action shooter, ideal for those boring breaks between two games. Compete against your friends in the arena and claim victory!
rows.description_html: Using everything you can find, your goal is to push your opponents off the map. Guns? Potatoes? (guys we should add potatoes) It's a deathmatch, no time to be picky. Especially because each hit you take the more knockback you receive from future hits, this means the game quickly escalates. Will you dash out of the way? Dash Realm is focused on multiplayer experiences with your friends and people online. No matter where you are, you are able to play locally, or online. • 2 to 4 Players in either Local or Online Multiplayer (No Single Player Mode) • Physics-based combat Weapons • 4 characters • 8 weapons • 2 maps • Custom round options

rows.name: The Vaults of Minos
rows.short_description: The Vaults of Minos is a fluid arcade Jump 'n Run with a gripping story and randomized levels. Every attempt to defeat your enemies will contain new traps, bosses, and challenges. Can you defeat your opponent and leave the cursed Vaults of Minos alive?
rows.description_html: It definitely hits the 8-bit music of the 80s like nobody’s business (...) if you’re a sucker for retro-styled sprites, well, you don’t have to look any further. LinuxGamingCentral Enter the trapped Vaults of Minos and stop your former teacher, the mad professor Nimroder, from waking the cursed King Minos. The Vaults of Minos is a fluid arcade Jump 'n Run with procedural generation - every attempt to prevent the unholy coalition between your opponent and the ancient tyrant will contain new traps, bosses, and challenges. Pick between two game modes and three difficulty levels. The Vaults of Minos features an abundance of different traps and enemies, a rich soundtrack, and colorful graphics. Try getting the highest score and unlock up to 24 achievements. Can you defeat your opponent and leave the cursed Vaults of Minos alive? Full controller support. Linux version available. Free, Libre, Open Source Software - Check out our page to get the source and other games!

rows.short_description: In Ironfell you can can gather stockpiles of resources to gain an unfair advantage over your enemies. The longer you’ve been playing for, the more resources you have, the stronger you are. And you take that full advantage into battles set in a massive persistent world.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic crusade across all of space and time in real time. From humble beginnings, you and your ponies can explore and conquer thousands of realms by land and by sea. Collect resources, build an army, and crush those who dare challenge you (or just plant flowers and raise ponies). In Ironfell you can can gather stockpiles of resources to gain an unfair advantage over your enemies. The longer you’ve been playing for, the more resources you have, the stronger you are. And you take that full advantage into battles set in a massive persistent world. Start a new rogue-like game every day or build an impregnable fortress that nobody can destroy. Over 2000 realms Dinosaurs! Over 100 units Whirlpools! Fast native app Castles! No in game chat or sign posts. Flagships! Everyone plays in the same massive persistent world.

rows.name: Singulive
rows.short_description: Singulive is the gateway for artists and audiences to the world of virtual reality with music as the main protagonist. A place designed to enjoy the live experience and take a step forward with spectacular possibilities.
rows.description_html: Singulive is an immersive experience that takes you to concert halls and live music experience! It is now a reality that artists' tours stop at your home. Your virtual reality device is now part of the tour schedules, something that has never happened before. Singulive is a virtual place that coexists with the physical concert halls that we all visit in real life to experience live music. It is a new way of understanding music by artists and spectators. You can live the experience alone or accompanied (up to four), look at the web premieres, write them down in your agenda and appoint your companions, with weekly releases Singulive will ensure that your contact with live music is constant and vibrant. Prepare your mind and passion for music for what Singulive offers you, social networks, news, premieres, archives, multiplayer experience and above all feel an active part of the live shows and venues you will enjoy. A calendar with different spaces, designed for a multitude of styles such as pop, rock, dance, blues, jazz, trap, classical. Exclusive concerts recorded for Singulive and that all Singuliners will enjoy intensely. Walk around and feel the atmosphere of our rooms, full of stories and songs Search in the interface for news, catalog, interviews, biography, etc. Meet your friends to enjoy a concert and share the experience. Meet new artists and become a fan Easy to master, in seconds you will be part of the Singulive World Enjoy artists of all styles Concert venues will never be far away again Join Singulive's social networks to live the full experience every day of your life.

rows.name: Dragon And Home
rows.short_description: Dragon and Home is a sandbox MMORPG where players can choose freely how they desire to play. Whether you want to play as a courageous adventurer, or you want to experience the tranquil rural lifestyles, growing plants, and feeding animals with your friends in the Homeland, you can find it all.
rows.description_html: Join Official Discord Welcome to Discord, where there are developers and loyal players! About the Game Background Story After an earth-shattering fight between the two Dragons, the Tree of Life was severely damaged and was on the verge of collapse. The Tree of Life condensed its remaining energy into the Seed of World as a means of self-preservation. However, the overflowing energy brought about concerning changes to the native creatures on the continents. The Dragon of Light gathers capable people from all over the world to protect the Tree of Life and save this dilapidated world. You woke up in the outpost as the hero to save the world chosen by the Tree of Life. You will encountered the enigmatic Witch Sakura. With the help of Sakura, you will learn survival skills and embark on an unpredictable adventure. You and Sakura need to travel throughout different continents, retrieve all the Seed of World and find out the way to sustain and save the dying Tree of Life. Accompanied by Sakura, You can step into the wonderful unknown world Sakura will be your guide in the adventure, leading you to explore the unknown and mysterious world: many bizarre creatures are hidden here, many dangers await, and all of these are waiting to be revealed as you start your adventure. Gather the materials you need by collecting, mining, hunting, fishing, and other fun content, and confront the challenge of surviving in the changing weather system. Don't forget to team up with your friends on the adventure, or find new friends on the way. Take your well-forged weapons and go on an adventure There are three classes to choose from: Warrior, Mage, Hunter. The class you play depends on the equipment and the weapons you wear. Experience a variety of combats by freely switching equipment. You can increase the equipment's attributes by forging and inlaying them with Soul Stones, creating unique armors and weapons, enriching your combat skills, and rejecting the same boring battles. In offline mode, customize your ideal Utopia Dragon and Home provide thousands of styles of building materials, furniture, and decorative plants for designers to choose from. Even beginner architectures can complete a design easily using the help of our Building-AI. If there are no restrictions, how will you build your Utopia? Relax and enjoy rural idyll with your friends Invite friends to live the life you want in shared Homelands. You can try out weaving and tanning leather and make yourself new clothes; you can take care of your farm and treats your friends with a generous meal with different dishes; you can also breed and train high-quality mounts and become a happy rancher. With the Homeland’s free trading system, you can also become a merchant and place your excess materials at a stall. Explore and dive into the dangerous Boss levels Bosses are located in the secret realms of the continents where dangers and traps are hidden. You can team up with your friends and explore these areas together. Apart from fine equipment and weapons, teamwork and wisdom are also the keys to the battle. Remember to bring the potion you brewed for it can lower the difficulty of fighting the boss and make you more courageous in the thrilling battle.

rows.name: The Craft of the Samurai
rows.short_description: A short visual novel inspired from the works by the masters of Japanese cinema: Masaki Kobayashi, Akira Kurosawa, Hideo Gosha.
rows.description_html: 'The Craft of the Samurai' is a short visual novel set in medieval Japan. If names such as Kurosawa, Gosha, Kobayashi bring you back fond memories, then 'The Craft of the Samurai' should be of interest to you. If you are not familiar with the works of these directors, then let 'The Craft of the Samurai' be your guide into the world of Japanese classics. Synopsis. Japan. 17th century. On the outskirts of a village, an old craftsman toils his days away. He bides his time to pass his business on to his heirs and retire from work. But this is until he is forced to take up the sword and revisit the path of violence. Visual style. Matthew Ryan's atmospheric illustrations are inspired by the masterpieces of samurai cinema. Among them: 'Seppuku', 'Yojimbo', 'Three Outlaw Samurai'. Paired with authentic framing, it will be an unforgettable experience for you. Music. Kevin MacLeod's compositions complement the story and boost emotions. Player's choice. No. Follow the story and don't get distracted. Gameplay length. Under an hour.

You must find hidden clues and objects of interest that slowly reveal the haunting story. Feel the build-up of fear as you traverse the forest and make your way through the House.

Your ordeal has left you exhausted and delirious but you start discovering horrific artifacts and gruesome remains. As you make your way through the forest, you approach a gloomy house in the middle of the island. Discover the forbidden history and terrifying secrets that slowly reveal themselves in Wardwell House. Wardwell House is an innovative and realistic horror game with outstanding atmosphere. rows.short_description: Inspired by infamous Clicker- type games, TWG is a mixture of casual AFK- point grinder, torture simulator and weird RPG. It allows you to upgrade torture methods, customize the torturing environment, and simply dive into ocean of silly violence against a lame gamedev.
rows.description_html: Totally Working Game (TWG)- is a 2D Physics- based Game, inspired by various Clicker titles, for wasting time and simply fooling around- also, it is a torture simulator of a gamedev, who made some..... lame video games. Your aim is..... not fully clear, as you just have to cause the gamedev more and more suffering, using G.I.F.'s (Game Inquisitor Foundations') torture devices. special Features You Can Expect 7 Upgradable torture Methods 5 bonus helpers Over 20 various to-be-answered questions and perks 5 unlockable environments and character stages (as well as customizable ones) Tons of mindless, pointless fun while torturing your least favourite dev! customize Your Gameplay! While the game provides you with 5 backgrounds ('GIF Worlds') and character heads to choose from, at certain stage you will get an option to upload your own backgrounds and character appearances into the game. Simply go to upgrade screen, and choose the Heads option to start customizing gamedev's face!

rows.short_description: Ha_Bits is an Adventure and platformer game for windows and Mac OS with a neo-noir cyberpunk setting.
rows.description_html: In a simulation, programs delicate coexistence is coming to an end. Virus rise and many sectors are being destroyed. Lead, a shattered program with a lost purpose, will have to take the fight against them and a shadowy organization; even if it means, dealing with her past mistakes. Seeking answers in the very end, Lead will get to know the best and the worst of Ha_Bits town and its inhabitants, and their connection with the mysterious Overclock; when time runs out and only seven cycles remain. Features: A survival horror Metroidvania featuring two different worlds to be explored, the haunting and beautiful Ha_Bits town and the Overclock: a dangerous plane of existence that keeps many secrets and knowledge. Two different game modes connected to tell the story and integrated on the game’s world. Dress up to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. Each with unique powers and skills. Original art and soundtrack to entertain you up to the end of cycles. A story full of mysteries and riddles to be solved on the simulation. A cute cat to save your game! :3

rows.name: Peblito: Rock and Roll
rows.short_description: Peblito: Rock and Roll is a 3D platformer where you play as Peblito, a small yet determined pebble, on his journey through a mystical volcano. Dash, swing, and roll your way through a variety of obstacles in this lighthearted platforming adventure inspired by 90's platforming collect-a-thons!
rows.description_html: Peblito: Rock and Roll is a 3D platformer where you play as Peblito, a small yet determined pebble, on his journey through a mystical volcano on the day of the foraging festival. The foraging festival event marks young rocklings first steps into adulthood and tasks them with gathering enough food for their respective household. On today, of all days, our dear hero Peblito has accidentally overslept! Fortunately for him, there’s a stubborn old stone waiting to lend a hand! As a young rock, Peblito must venture forth in search of fruit for his village's foraging festival. Guided by a wise elder, Peblito stumbles upon an underground cavern lost to time, leading to the source of life on his island. Help guide Peblito through his underground adventure, utilizing his special abilities break through walls and crystals, traverse over lava sunken temples, and roll deep below the roots of the mother tree. Dash, Burst, Swing and Roll your way through this 3D platforming adventure, inspired by the games of the 90's platforming collect-a-thon era. Peblito: Rock and Roll is a student capstone game that was developed over 2 semesters at FIEA (Florida Interactive Entertainment Academy) during Cohort 17. Full Steam Achievement support coming soon!

rows.name: Escape from the Lockdown: The Demon Fortress (Steam Version) - Day 1
rows.short_description: Team up with the 9 heroes as the 'Puzzle Solving Hero' and solve the mysteries of the Demon Fortress!
rows.description_html: SCRAP's famous online Real Escape Game is now available on Steam! 'Escape from the Lockdown: The Demon Fortress', which has attracted over 35,000 players, is now playable on Steam! To celebrate this moment, the fee Demo version is available. Try out the challenging puzzles and unfold a shocking ending to the story...! *The story/puzzles in this game are completely identical to the same game you can purchase from our SCRAP Bookings website. Story In the world you live in, humanity lives in fear of the demons. 9 heroes headed to the Demon Fortress in order to defeat the Demon King. The heroes have not been heard from since. The world will be swallowed by darkness if nothing is done. One day, your 'Communication Crystal' rings. In the crystal ball, you see... the heroes who were thought to be dead! 'Finally! It's connected! We've been confined in the Demon Fortress's prison! Please, can you save us? We've found this...' What the weakened heroes revealed was a map of the prison along with a note with cryptic puzzles. As the 'Puzzle Solving Hero' you start working right away! Will you be able to solve all the puzzles within the Demon Fortress, save the heroes, and bring peace to the world? Game Style In this game, you will become a Puzzle Solving Hero and work remotely with the 9 captured heroes. Watch a series of videos, listen carefully to the heroes' conversations, solve all the puzzles, and discover the mystery of the Demon Fortress! Who are we? SCRAP has been creating immersive puzzle events since 2007, pioneering the new genre of Real World Adventure, which has become a driving force in the entertainment world. Real Escape Game is held in unique places such as schools, ruined hospitals, amusement parks, stadiums, and even whole city districts. The events have built enthusiasm and have attracted over 7.4 million players all over the world.

rows.name: Low Light Combat
rows.short_description: Low Light Combat is a free competitive multiplayer shooter where light is your only weapon. Matches take place during a rapidly changing day and night cycle, meaning your fast paced fights quickly become tense and thrilling battles of wit.
rows.description_html: LIGHT IS YOUR WEAPON Low Light Combat is a free competitive multiplayer shooter where light is your only weapon. Matches take place during a rapidly changing day and night cycle, meaning your fast paced fights quickly become tense and thrilling battles of wit. TIME IS YOUR LIFE In LLC, your health, ammo, and stamina are all tied to a single resource: Time. That means everything from firing your weapon and taking damage, to sprinting and shining your flashlight will all deplete your time. To replenish your time you must either defeat other players, or touch the reactor found in the middle of the map. But you must act fact because time... is fleeting. ONE OF THE FIRST GAMES TO USE UNREAL ENGINE 5 LLC is one of the first games ever developed using Unreal Engine 5 Early Access, which means it takes full advantage of Lumen, which powers the real time dynamic global illumination featured in the game, and Nanite, which enables an astounding level of detail in the geometry. OPEN SOURCE FOR EVERYONE LLC is completely open source, so if you want to dive headfirst into the project file and learn how we did what we did, you can do so. Regardless of if you're a big name developer or a hobbyist programmer, any and all can learn from Low Light Combat. You can download the source code here! FEATURES Multiplayer matches based around light and time management Rapid day/night cycle Realistic real time dynamic lighting Cutting edge engine technology FAQ How much does Low Light Combat cost? Low Light Combat is completely free. How many people can play Low Light Combat together? We recommend servers of no more than 10 players for the best LLC experience. How long was Low Light Combat in development? We developed this game for just over a month to see what we could make with UE5.

rows.name: Venture Within
rows.short_description: In Venture Within, a deep-sea roguelite game, you take on the role of Alice Tharp as she enters magically altered hydrothermal vent towers where she must battle against strange creatures and avoid natural hazards to find her mother and her lost research team.
rows.description_html: Venture Within, a deep-sea roguelite game, takes you inside magically altered, deep-sea hydrothermal vents. As Alice Tharp, daughter of the famous Geomancer Dr. Talia Tharp, you travel to the submarine, Simon, to join your mother’s research expedition. When you arrive, the entire expedition team is missing! To find them, climb your way through vent tower walls, battle magically altered creatures, and avoid natural hazards, while upgrading your skills! Nearly one hundred years ago, the world discovered magic, and everything changed, including the pursuit of scientific research. As the world focused on arcane studies, science was viewed as unnecessary. However, a small group of mages still saw value in science and formed Aeon Academy. Academy researchers use magic and science to address questions about our world. Now, the Academy has sent its first expedition to study deep-sea hydrothermal vents, led by Dr. Talia Tharp aboard the submarine Simon. Excited to join her mother’s expedition aboard the Simon, Alice arrives to find a nearly empty, damaged submarine. Only her mother’s magic rock, Silex, and the submarine’s Mechanist, Fritz Boulder, remain on board. Together, the three must find the lost expedition team. By returning to the hydrothermal vents visited by the expedition, you will unravel this mystery – and, hopefully, find your mother too. SURVIVE Help Alice survive attacks from magically altered creatures based on fauna found in today’s deep-sea hydrothermal ecosystems. Fight off everything from tube worms to animated sulfide minerals. COLLECT AND HARVEST Collect up to 25 minerals and scientific items dropped by the lost geomancers. Activate mineral samples for temporary boosts to your skills and carry scientific items in your field bag to passively increase your skills. Harvest Pyrite to fuel the Simon’s 3D printer and print permanent upgrades. RESEARCH AND UPGRADE Research the items you find and creatures you defeat to gain “research points”. Use these points to unlock up to 16 unique 3D Blueprints for the GeoTech, the Simon’s 3D Printer. LEARN SCIENCE Enjoy a window into the deep-sea marine geology of hydrothermal vents. In game geologic events, scientific items, minerals and rocks, vent types, and the descriptions of hydrothermal circulation are all based on scientific data and practices. What would you expect from a game funded by the United States National Science Foundation? In fact, game development was supported by National Science Foundation grant #OCE-1753354.

rows.name: Smash MAGA! Trump Zombie Apocalypse: Twilight of Empire
rows.short_description: Anti-fascist gamers fight the Trump Zombie plague in this spree of rioting and looting!
rows.description_html: It is the Twilight of Empire … and the dawn of a new era. Escalations on new terrains have opened up the fight for liberation; a new threat against the waning death rattles of all order gains momentum. The Trump Virus infected fascist hordes have again made an electoral putsch against the equally desperate and dystopian Neoliberal police state. Both parties have already made everyone their enemies and their inevitable downfall when they gambled with our lives in their endless civil wars and colonial massacres. Unfathomable loss, accelerated apocalypse, a climate collapsed. But another end of the world was possible: a movement arises to meet the demands of the mad moment. We know only one future exists: a future without borders, without classes or nations, where the land is returned and healed by the people who love the land. CONVENTION CRASHERS There is a spectre haunting the country – the spectre of democracy! While the fascist MAGA Zombies have consolidated their party and once again rallied around a flailing, half-dead Trump, the Neolibs have exposed themselves to be genocidal imperialists at core, caving to and aligning with the fascists instead of meeting the needs of the people they seek to rule. And now they are hosting their jingoistic spectacles, a charade, a circus, a coronation for their champions in major cities they have locked down under Martial Law. They say it is the final election, the most important vote ever. But that is a threat backed by violence, a claim to eternal occupation under autocracy, a glimmer of the future they seek to impose. But the people are not only Uncommitted, they are dedicated to tearing down this facsimile of democracy, the illusion of choice. Protesters have been building momentum against the machinations of empire in the form of decentralized anarchy everywhere: disruptions, direct action, encampments, mutual aid, dual power. People are tired of the symbolic marches that give more power to the simulacrum; instead, underground networks have been activated to answer the call for increased activity! And it is finally the day of the conventions, when pig forces make their big announcement…..will it be the dissolution of the “great american experiment” in favor of a fascist future, or will the neolibs triangulate and pacify the masses in acceptance of a soft kill reform? Only one thing is certain, this shithole country is so cooked! MAD MAGA Worsening climate collapse has spurred far-right actors to call for a Convoy to Collapse, an accelerationist mass of oil-guzzling vehicular rampagers, destroying what little nature is left in pursuit of their endless super-freeway- One Last Lane, they say. And anyone who stands in their way will feel the flame. MAGA is MAD as HELL! But the people are not going to take it anymore! Land and water defenders have been making plans to wreck the onslaught of chuds and truckers, stop the desertification and regrow the forest! See you on the other side of this randomized endless highway to climate hell, comrade! ANOTHER INSURRECTION IS POSSIBLE The final election was claimed victorious by the reformist parties, but the fascists zombified mobs literally ate the brains of all the toothless liberal tendencies, who predictably ended up acquiescing to MAGA!. With Trump being declared Dictator for ALL days, declaring democracy as dead as his biggest supporters, the Left has no choice but to unite against this monster. We are all Antifa now! And it is up to us to smash this fascist coup! What happens next is anyone’s guess, but the future will be written by those willing to fight- and when we say never again, we mean right here and right now! It’s time to Storm the Capitol, this time, from the Left! SMASH TO THE FUTURE The aftermaths of the insurrections and revolutions of the 21st century left a vacuum that aspiring tech overlords exploited to exert power over all of society. The future was handed over to automation, and this sleeping giant reigned supreme for a thousand years, leaving people dormant, pacified, dependent, and confused. The numbers are rising but our humanity worsens from a joyless neo-feudal existence, so propagandized through the retro-neon hypnotic promises of a luxury gay space communism that never panned out… Basic needs are met, but genuine experiences and meaning have enshittified- people now has less autonomy and freedom than ever before, this might even be the fucking matrix… But people are ready to wipe the futurist nostalgic garbage off the face of the planet, that is, before the machine’s plans to expand their operating systems to all corners of the known universe through the spacefaring MAGA X program goes online, operated by the direct descendents of Musk and Trump’s great great great great test-tube grandchildren. The thing is, hackers have already found a vulnerability, and although Earth seems to be a lost cause in this timeline, we can prevent the fascist virus from escaping the ruin it has created before it brings the disease to other worlds! -- Defend The Forest - The newest level of Smash MAGA! “If You Build It, We Will Burn It!” Their fascist ecocidal ambitions now laid bare, establishment forces seek to build Cop City, the largest police “training center” in the country, situated on top of the largest forest within an urban area. This pig playground has plans to include weapons and explosives testing, a mock city in which to simulate battles with resistant civilians, and would train cops from departments across the nation (‘outside agitators’). Cop City is the end-game of late stage capitalism: their response to the glaring contradictions and growing unrest is to drop the veneer of democracy and double down on the repression, culminating in these militarized cop city feudal empires to maintain their racist classist status quo well into an apocalyptic climate collapsed dystopian future. This vision could not be more clearly demonstrated by the overwhelming repression of those fighting to defend the forest, including the murder of our comrade Tortuguita and the bogus arrests of over 45 protesters who are now facing draconian “domestic terror” charges. But despite mass repression, the movement continues to grow and evolve: using an ecosystem of tactics, forest defenders have made serious setbacks to the Cop City project. The future is unwritten: our collective survival will be determined by those willing to fight. Defend the Earth by any means necessary! Abolish the police and Stop Cop City! For this level, we introduce a few new elements to the classic Smash MAGA! Riot and Rally arcade action! Earth-Rippers - these clear-cutting deforesters are modeled after the land-rippers of Lutzerath. They have one goal - kill all trees! A few bricks or molotovs will take out these anti-life tech monstrosities. B3 Bombers - Thanks to bipartisan imperialism, the state is now in possession of a fleet of billion-dollar drone-operated nuclear stealth bombers, and utilizing them in targeted operations against the protesters. If you see signs of an impending drone strike, RUN! Tree-Sitters - Comrades are occupying the trees and giving themselves a vantage point in which to best resist the encroaching police menace! Hidden all over the forest, land defenders are at the forefront of struggle for climate revolution! Defend The Forest is an antifascist action-packed rally-and-riot crowd-brawling tower-defense experience that can only be matched by going out and participating in real-world struggles against environmental encroachment. Stop Cop City Everywhere! Check these collectives and websites for more info on the Stop Cop City movement, find comrades in your area, and get active! This Fifth of November.... 'Civil War' Expansion Released! With the spectre of fascist civil war haunting the midterm elections in the so-called United States, imminent system collapse is obvious to all. There is no future left but to fight it out in chaos of the streets – or in the latest version of Smash MAGA: Trump Zombie Apocalypse! This expansion continues the timeline into Biden’s neoliberal nightmare with six new action-packed levels: “March Against Dystopia”, “Dualing Protests”, “”Cop Island”, “Bicycle Bomber”, “Civil War”, and “Ancient Future”. Join the struggle in single-player mode or fight with your friends online against new enemies including police riot trucks, digi-dogs. tanks, Romanesque MAGA LARPers, peace police, and more. Hordes of brainwashed right-wing extremists have become infected with the Trump Zombie Plague and threaten the free world with fake-news-propagating hate speech. But there is one force that can stop them – anti-fascism! Gamers, rise up and confront the infectious, indoctrinated mobs in Smash MAGA! Defend vaccination sites against diseased MAGA zealots! Disrupt white supremacist speaking events and dismantle symbols of colonization! And slap masks on science-denying fools right in their uncovered faces with a triple crossbow! Unapologetically anti-fascist, Smash MAGA! Trump Zombie Apocalypse is a politically-charged smash-and-run retro action adventure game (in the style of Smash TV) where you fight right-wing zombies at scenes like the Capitol Hill Riots and other historic events of our time. Version 1.1 release introduces new maps and full internet multiplayer and two player couch co-op support: fight fascists with your friends in cooperative, deathmatch, and capture the flag laser tag modes, and compete in online tournaments. After the failed coup, the forces of the Trump virus lingered and spread a new wave of propaganda to reanimate the zombified hordes. Grifting ignorance and hate, right-wing chaos agents mainstream the scapegoating of the vulnerable and marginalized, creating an era of stochastic terror. Vigilante assaults on public institutions erodes healthcare and education, the right to abortion was the first to go in a Christian nationalist putsch. Meanwhile, the Neoliberals wanted to normalize the crises. Content with letting the left drain their resources battling the undead fascists in the streets, the Neolibs triangulate and expand the militarization of the police with automation and hyper-technology to maintain their rule and geopolitical power. Dystopian authoritarianism accelerates climate collapse. Animal populations disappear, entire towns and lakes evaporate, perennial fires and hurricanes make survival untenable. Misanthropy spreads as conditions worsened unevenly. Billions more thrown into poverty and desperation; world leaders choose sides in future wars. An emergency election is held, and both parties lose. Without a majority or plurality, the internal contradictions prove too great for democracy to hold together the diverging realities. Ubiquitous political violence escalates to larger skirmishes, regional conflicts spread to global theaters. MAGA secedes under a familiar banner and makes the first strike… Civil War returns in the age of nuclear fascism.

People are tired of the symbolic marches that give more power to the simulacrum; instead, underground networks have been activated to answer the call for increased activity! And it is finally the day of the conventions, when pig forces make their big announcement…..will it be the dissolution of the “great american experiment” in favor of a fascist future, or will the neolibs triangulate and pacify the masses in acceptance of a soft kill reform? Only one thing is certain, this shithole country is so cooked! MAD MAGA Worsening climate collapse has spurred far-right actors to call for a Convoy to Collapse, an accelerationist mass of oil-guzzling vehicular rampagers, destroying what little nature is left in pursuit of their endless super-freeway- One Last Lane, they say. And anyone who stands in their way will feel the flame. MAGA is MAD as HELL! But the people are not going to take it anymore! Land and water defenders have been making plans to wreck the onslaught of chuds and truckers, stop the desertification and regrow the forest! See you on the other side of this randomized endless highway to climate hell, comrade! ANOTHER INSURRECTION IS POSSIBLE The final election was claimed victorious by the reformist parties, but the fascists zombified mobs literally ate the brains of all the toothless liberal tendencies, who predictably ended up acquiescing to MAGA!. With Trump being declared Dictator for ALL days, declaring democracy as dead as his biggest supporters, the Left has no choice but to unite against this monster. We are all Antifa now! And it is up to us to smash this fascist coup! What happens next is anyone’s guess, but the future will be written by those willing to fight- and when we say never again, we mean right here and right now! It’s time to Storm the Capitol, this time, from the Left! SMASH TO THE FUTURE The aftermaths of the insurrections and revolutions of the 21st century left a vacuum that aspiring tech overlords exploited to exert power over all of society. The future was handed over to automation, and this sleeping giant reigned supreme for a thousand years, leaving people dormant, pacified, dependent, and confused. The numbers are rising but our humanity worsens from a joyless neo-feudal existence, so propagandized through the retro-neon hypnotic promises of a luxury gay space communism that never panned out… Basic needs are met, but genuine experiences and meaning have enshittified- people now has less autonomy and freedom than ever before, this might even be the fucking matrix… But people are ready to wipe the futurist nostalgic garbage off the face of the planet, that is, before the machine’s plans to expand their operating systems to all corners of the known universe through the spacefaring MAGA X program goes online, operated by the direct descendents of Musk and Trump’s great great great great test-tube grandchildren. The thing is, hackers have already found a vulnerability, and although Earth seems to be a lost cause in this timeline, we can prevent the fascist virus from escaping the ruin it has created before it brings the disease to other worlds! -- Defend The Forest - The newest level of Smash MAGA! “If You Build It, We Will Burn It!” Their fascist ecocidal ambitions now laid bare, establishment forces seek to build Cop City, the largest police “training center” in the country, situated on top of the largest forest within an urban area. This pig playground has plans to include weapons and explosives testing, a mock city in which to simulate battles with resistant civilians, and would train cops from departments across the nation (‘outside agitators’). Cop City is the end-game of late stage capitalism: their response to the glaring contradictions and growing unrest is to drop the veneer of democracy and double down on the repression, culminating in these militarized cop city feudal empires to maintain their racist classist status quo well into an apocalyptic climate collapsed dystopian future. This vision could not be more clearly demonstrated by the overwhelming repression of those fighting to defend the forest, including the murder of our comrade Tortuguita and the bogus arrests of over 45 protesters who are now facing draconian “domestic terror” charges. But despite mass repression, the movement continues to grow and evolve: using an ecosystem of tactics, forest defenders have made serious setbacks to the Cop City project. The future is unwritten: our collective survival will be determined by those willing to fight. Defend the Earth by any means necessary! Abolish the police and Stop Cop City! For this level, we introduce a few new elements to the classic Smash MAGA! Riot and Rally arcade action! Earth-Rippers - these clear-cutting deforesters are modeled after the land-rippers of Lutzerath. They have one goal - kill all trees! A few bricks or molotovs will take out these anti-life tech monstrosities. B3 Bombers - Thanks to bipartisan imperialism, the state is now in possession of a fleet of billion-dollar drone-operated nuclear stealth bombers, and utilizing them in targeted operations against the protesters. If you see signs of an impending drone strike, RUN! Tree-Sitters - Comrades are occupying the trees and giving themselves a vantage point in which to best resist the encroaching police menace! Hidden all over the forest, land defenders are at the forefront of struggle for climate revolution! Defend The Forest is an antifascist action-packed rally-and-riot crowd-brawling tower-defense experience that can only be matched by going out and participating in real-world struggles against environmental encroachment. Stop Cop City Everywhere! Check these collectives and websites for more info on the Stop Cop City movement, find comrades in your area, and get active! This Fifth of November.... 'Civil War' Expansion Released! With the spectre of fascist civil war haunting the midterm elections in the so-called United States, imminent system collapse is obvious to all. There is no future left but to fight it out in chaos of the streets – or in the latest version of Smash MAGA: Trump Zombie Apocalypse! This expansion continues the timeline into Biden’s neoliberal nightmare with six new action-packed levels: “March Against Dystopia”, “Dualing Protests”, “”Cop Island”, “Bicycle Bomber”, “Civil War”, and “Ancient Future”. Join the struggle in single-player mode or fight with your friends online against new enemies including police riot trucks, digi-dogs. tanks, Romanesque MAGA LARPers, peace police, and more. Hordes of brainwashed right-wing extremists have become infected with the Trump Zombie Plague and threaten the free world with fake-news-propagating hate speech. But there is one force that can stop them – anti-fascism! Gamers, rise up and confront the infectious, indoctrinated mobs in Smash MAGA! Defend vaccination sites against diseased MAGA zealots! Disrupt white supremacist speaking events and dismantle symbols of colonization! And slap masks on science-denying fools right in their uncovered faces with a triple crossbow! Unapologetically anti-fascist, Smash MAGA! Trump Zombie Apocalypse is a politically-charged smash-and-run retro action adventure game (in the style of Smash TV) where you fight right-wing zombies at scenes like the Capitol Hill Riots and other historic events of our time. Version 1.1 release introduces new maps and full internet multiplayer and two player couch co-op support: fight fascists with your friends in cooperative, deathmatch, and capture the flag laser tag modes, and compete in online tournaments. After the failed coup, the forces of the Trump virus lingered and spread a new wave of propaganda to reanimate the zombified hordes. Grifting ignorance and hate, right-wing chaos agents mainstream the scapegoating of the vulnerable and marginalized, creating an era of stochastic terror. Vigilante assaults on public institutions erodes healthcare and education, the right to abortion was the first to go in a Christian nationalist putsch. Meanwhile, the Neoliberals wanted to normalize the crises. Content with letting the left drain their resources battling the undead fascists in the streets, the Neolibs triangulate and expand the militarization of the police with automation and hyper-technology to maintain their rule and geopolitical power. Dystopian authoritarianism accelerates climate collapse. Animal populations disappear, entire towns and lakes evaporate, perennial fires and hurricanes make survival untenable. Misanthropy spreads as conditions worsened unevenly. Billions more thrown into poverty and desperation; world leaders choose sides in future wars. An emergency election is held, and both parties lose. Without a majority or plurality, the internal contradictions prove too great for democracy to hold together the diverging realities. Ubiquitous political violence escalates to larger skirmishes, regional conflicts spread to global theaters. MAGA secedes under a familiar banner and makes the first strike… Civil War returns in the age of nuclear fascism.

rows.name: Club Soccer Director 2022
rows.short_description: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own club, in Club Soccer Director 2022 a fast-paced Football Club Management Game. Download Club Soccer Director 2022 now for FREE & start your Football management journey.
rows.description_html: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own, in Club Soccer Director 2022 a fast-paced Football Club Management Game This is your chance to develop and shape the club the way you want it, hiring the manager you want, recruiting a title-winning squad, and dealing with all the busy day-to-day business of your Football Club. Club Soccer Director 2022 gives you the chance to manage all aspects of the football club and exert your influence over the manager Can you deliver success to the owners and the board? Will you keep the manager and players happy? Can you win over the fans? Download Club Soccer Director 2022 now for FREE & start your Football management journey. Be more than just a Football Manager! NEW FEATURES • NEW IMPROVED 3D FOOTBALL ENVIRONMENT • NEW STAFF ROLES • NEW MANAGER INTERACTION • NEW TRANSFER NEGOTIATIONS • NEW SQUAD NUMBERS • NEW FORMATIONS • NEW PLAYER STATS LIKE PACE, CROSSING, PREFERRED FOOT • NEW PLAYER, CLUB & STAFF DATA FOR 21/22 SEASON • NEW STAFF ATTRIBUTES • NEW SCOUT HUB • NEW TEAM OF THE WEEK • NEW STAFF & RETIRING PLAYERS CAN BE OFFERED NEW STAFF ROLES • NEW INTERNATIONAL SQUAD VIEWS • NEW PLAYER POSITIONS • NEW DIARY PLANNING & TRAINING Any many more improvements to managers tactics, transfer market, press conferences, headlines, manager interviews, TV money, UI and more CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF FOOTBALL CLUBS Choose from 820 Football clubs in 38 leagues from 14 different countries across the world. Create your legacy and build your own team from scratch including home country, club, stadium name, and kit design and take them to the top! UNRIVALLED CLUB-LEVEL FOOTBALL MANAGEMENT Manage every aspect of your Football club’s development and how you invest funds. Develop & upgrade your club's facilities, inc the stadium, fitness centre, medical, training ground, & youth Academy. Increase revenues by negotiating sponsorships. Hire & fire your management team and build your dream squad by negotiating transfers & offers with player agents as well as handling contract negotiations with players and staff alike. EVERY DECISION COUNTS Just like in real life, your decisions affect the attitude of the board, team morale, & even the fans. How you engage with press and media, ticket prices, the quality of your squad & the potential of your Academy prospects all have a bearing. LIFELIKE STATS ENGINE Comprehensive live-action stats engine mirrors real-life player behaviour and match outcomes, processing over 1000 decisions per game & generates real-time statistics for both individual players and teams. DEVELOP THE CLUB Now in beautiful 3D you can create your own area for the club & develop your stadium, training ground, academy, facilities, fitness centre & medical facilities. MATCH HIGHLIGHTS CSD22 shows key match highlights during the game so you can see those key goals and misses! TACTICAL FREEDOM Leave key decisions to the Football manager or overrule him by implementing your own play style and deciding on team line-up, formation, in and out-of-possession tactics, substitutes and more. COMPREHENSIVE PLAYER DATABASE Buy or loan players from a database of over 30,000 players, each with their own unique play styles, stats, personalities and behaviours. CSD22 continuously generates new players on a regular basis, ensuring you have plenty of talent to choose from whether you’ve been in the hot seat for 1 season or 10! Player cycles continue beyond the pitch as some retiring players go into staff roles just as they do in real life! FULL EDITOR CSD22 has a Full in-game editor that allows you to edit Football team names, ground, kits, players avatars, staff avatars and share them with other players DEVELOPED BY A REAL FOOTBALL COACH /MANAGER! Lead developer Jim Scott is both a manager & Football coach, bringing over 18 years of industry experience to Club Soccer Director 2022
