rows.name: Kenopsia
rows.short_description: Follow Amelia, a stressed and overworked gamedev (or as people in the industry call it... Just a gamedev) through a surreal trip with three distinctly different game modes.
rows.description_html: The door shuts behind you and the sound rings eerily throughout the office. Wasn’t this place bustling with activity just a few minutes ago? What happened to everyone?... And what was that in the corner of your eye? Explore a surreal office… and more! Kenopsia is an adventure game where you travel between different dimensions to find your way out of an strangely empty office populated by visions from its past. Follow Amelia, a stressed and overworked gamedev through a surreal trip with three distinctly different game modes: A first person adventure game in a strange 3D office environment, where you search for clues and solve problems to find your way forward. *A challenging 2,5D platforming game, where you jump between precarious platforms over a neon-glowing data-sea. *A 2D top-down fantasy gatherer-brawler. Set out from a beleaguered town with your trusty hammer at hand to gather the resources needed to save it. Battle against the demonic hordes trying to destroy your home. Each of the modes depict the games narrative in different ways, from fully voiceacted narration and conversation, text-based dialouges, to pure ludo-narrative. Each a part in telling the story of Amelia. Ultimately, though the games themselves are very different, Kenopsia is a game about what it is like to be overwhelmed, stressed, and alone, and the importance of daring to lean on others. Who are Team Cwab? Team Cwab is a group of 13 developers who came together at Futuregames Academy to create an ambitious and creative experience over 6 months. Just like the mighty crab we are hardy yet respectful, dedicated and hardworking but with a playful sense of humor and a soft and caring heart within. Plus, we both go great with tartar sauce.

rows.name: The Darkest Tales — Into the Nightmare
rows.short_description: When a nightmare creeps into reality, the only ones that can help are those whose magical powers we’ve believed in since childhood. A brave teddy bear and his fairy sidekick head to the darker side of “happily ever after” to rescue his owner, Alicia.
rows.description_html: Join a stuffed bear named Teddy and his magical fairy sidekick Lighty on a high-stakes journey through a nightmarish realm of sinister dreams and distorted childhood fairytales to rescue Alicia — Teddy’s now grown-up owner. Who else will fight for the life of the girl, if not her once most loved toy? The Darkest Tales — Into the Nightmare is a free-to-play prologue, bringing players into the first two chapters of Teddy and Lighty’s journey across this familiar yet twisted world. Are you ready to leave your dusty old toy box and finally take on a real challenge? Do you have what it takes to hack, slash, and dash your way through hostile lands crawling with deadly traps and bloodthirsty monsters? If yes, then turn the page and immerse yourself in The Darkest Tales . Happily Never After Meet familiar characters from childhood bedtime stories, but don’t expect any hugs and kisses. The wolves are out for blood, the great beanstalk is crawling with bugs and carnivorous plants, and Little Red Riding Hood… well, she may just slice you up in two. Teddy Scissorpaws Don’t let looks fool you — Teddy may be soft, but with Lighty by his side, our heroes make for a formidable duo. Turn old scissors into magic-powered swords, needles into powerful arrows and grappling hooks, but use your mana wisely, so you don’t lose your stitches. Remember, all is fair in the race to rescue Alicia. Ahead Lies Only Darkness Each chapter takes place in a recognizable yet distorted fairytale world rife with combat, obstacles, and secrets. Put your skills to the test against tough opponents and bring back hope to dreamlands now engulfed by the forces of evil. Gain experience, master and branch out your skill tree, and reach the depths of the nightmare to come out victorious. The Darkest Tales is a game with deep and mysterious lore. As you progress through each page of this story, you’ll begin to unveil the secrets behind this nightmarish world. How will this tale end? It will be up to you to decide. Progress saved in the free version will be automatically carried over into the full version of The Darkest Tales .

rows.name: Fiasco Restoration and Repair
rows.short_description: Fiasco Restoration and Repair is a game about free-form art restoration without any of the proper tools or know how. The only resources available to you are those you can scavenge from the garage. Improvise solutions to complex problems, make mistakes, and restore the artwork no matter the cost!
rows.description_html: A horribly damaged, priceless work of art lands at your doorstep and you have to repair it fast with whatever you have on hand. How would you do it? What would you use? This is the position Antonio Fiasco finds himself in. Some shady distant cousins have somehow come into possession of valuable and famous works of art that have been curiously damaged. They seem to misunderstand Antonio's arts degree, which is in culinary, and are employing his services to repair their strangely familiar pieces of artwork. Anyway, they're paying and Antonio isn't asking any questions! Freeform painting system. Dynamic fluids. Liquid mixing. Variety of Tools and Equipment. The restoration process is delicate and complex. There are many specialized processes and tools that Antonio is completely oblivious of. Instead, improvisation is key. There are a variety of items available in the garage to (hopefully) aid in the restoration process. The items come in the form of tools, various liquids, containers, food, and whatever else you find in the nooks and crannies of the garage.

rows.name: The Hunt
rows.short_description: The name says it all - in The Hunt, you get, well, hunted by hunters who will do everything they can to hunt you down. In order to survive, you must explore, scavenge, craft, and fight in order to survive. And if you survive and scavenge for long enough, there might just be a way to escape.
rows.description_html: The name says it all - in The Hunt, you get, well, hunted by hunters who will stop at nothing to wipe you off the face of the earth. In order to survive, you must explore the land, scavenge materials, loot buildings, make/find weapons and fend off the hunters. And if you survive and scavenge for long enough, there might just be a way to escape. You can: - Move around and fight in a first-person perspective - Explore an expansive world with many different buildings, structures, and trees. - Build and break any object in the environment, such as buildings and trees - Collect resources by harvesting trees/buildings or looting chests scattered across the map - Find and craft a variety of items and weapons - Engage in fast-paced combat against the hunters - Collect weapons and tools with different qualities, ranging from wood to diamond - Operate a forge that requires fuel to craft higher quality items - Escape the forest in two different ways, each requiring a different method and materials, covered in the tutorial.

rows.name: The Tipping Point
rows.short_description: Developed in collaboration with researchers, The Tipping Point is a fun and educational game about climate science. You play as an arctic climate researcher and must get off the ice sheet before it collapses. On your way, you will gather and analyze data about the ice sheet, before it is lost.
rows.description_html: THE ICE IS COLLAPSING! You play as Cass , an arctic climate researcher. You must get off the ice sheet before it collapses. On your way, you will gather and analyze data about the ice. Make your way over the collapsing ice sheet by jumping, sliding, and climbing. Reach abandoned research stations and gather data in a series of mini-games. Analyze the data and uncover what is happening to the climate. INVESTIGATE AND LEARN The Tipping Point is a 3D side-scroller developed in collaboration with real world researchers in an interdisciplinary effort (physicists, biologists, chemists, statisticians, and more). The things you do in The Tipping Point are based on what researchers do in the arctic in real life. As researchers do, you will compare the data you collect to previous data sets and investigate changes in the climate. UNCOVER WHAT IS HAPPENING TO THE ICE Solve the mystery of the tipping point and why the ice sheet is suddenly collapsing. THANKS TO Funded by EU Horizon 2020 , The Novo Nordisk Foundation , and NordForsk , The Tipping Point is and will forever be available for free. The research groups that contributed to the development of The Tipping Point are: TiPES is a large scientific collaboration with the aim to enhance the understanding of tipping points in the earth system. 18 partner institutions work together in more than 10 countries. The project is funded by EU Horizon 2020. Narwhal NordForsk project, consisting of Aarhus University, Chalmers University, Greenland Institute of Natural Resources, and more. The project is funded by NordForsk. INFO The game is free, without any in-app-purchases. Gameplay time is about 2 hours. Best enjoyed with a controller! DISCLAIMER The exact numbers in the game are not based on real findings. Only the scientific concepts behind the educational content are based on real research. The game takes liberty to dramatisize the covered science. We emplore you to think critically about the conveyed information and educate yourself via other sources. You can find correct information via the links above to the collaborating scientific organisations and institutions.

rows.name: Netherspace
rows.short_description: A sci-fi shoot'em'up game with heavy focus on upgrades experimentation, featuring two unlikely heroes that must work perfectly together, despite their share of secrets, to surpass their limits and succeed in eliminating a threat that might destroy both Earth and Andraxia if left unchecked.
rows.description_html: Netherspace is a retro shoot'em'up game that allows the player to travel through 100 levels of increasingly dangerous enemies. 20 merciless giant bosses will challenge the heroes and must be defeated in order for them to reach the conclusion of their difficult journey. Powerful weapons are available since the very beginning with more and more of them becoming available as the story progresses. 'Netherprime' can be collected from opponents defeated to enhance the various aspects of the prototype 'Netherpiercer' spaceship, allowing for greatly varied upgrades experimentation after every single boss vanquished. Netherspace features random enemy swarm formation making every single playthrough different than the last one.

rows.short_description: myMO (my Music Oasis) is an immersive multiplayer game built for a community of DJs, Musicians, and Music Fans to share beats while raving in a virtual world that features player customizable Dance Clubs, DJ Controlled Lights & Awesome Visual Effects.
rows.description_html: This Steam Early Access game is currently not a finished game and may or may not change significantly over the course of development. rows.name: Bridge of Dawn
rows.short_description: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life in this lighthearted and fun game for all ages.
rows.description_html: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life. Bridge of Dawn was created by Kimberly Blais, founder of Mama Makes Games, during a week-long Epic MegaJam. Set in the magical world of the Isle of Mist, Bridge of Dawn is a lighthearted and fun game for all ages. Featuring original music by Australian hip-hop star YNG Matryr, rising artist YNG SiLICON, and Madame X! Exciting arcade-style gameplay featuring one- and two-player support Easy-to-learn, hard-to-master action that challenges you to get the best score and time A fun fairytale-like story drawn from the fantasy world of the Isle of Mist Animated cutscenes with voice-acting by professional voice actor Erica Schroeder Race side-by-side or play 'Fox Tag' in local multiplayer Huge island racing map filled with plants, roads, rocks, and 'Timekeeper' opponents Dynamic music that adapts to your progress and performance NVidia Real-Time Ray Tracing (RTRT) support Available in English , Spanish , and Chinese , with full translation of subtitles and user interface Completely free and open-source to download, play, and modify however you'd like How to Play Goal: Reach the waypoints before the timer runs out. The higher you are when you touch the waypoint, the more points you get. Move: Use the mouse and WASD keys or a controller to move the fox. For two-player mode, the keyboard moves the first fox and the controller moves the second fox. Jump and Sprint: To jump, press Spacebar or the A/Y button on the controller. The longer you hold jump, the higher you'll jump when you release it. To sprint, hold Shift or the B/X button on the controller. Fox Tag : In Fox Tag mode, players take turn being 'it' and trying to tag the other player. Open-Sourced Fun Bridge of Dawn is fully open-sourced under the highly permissive MIT license! You can download the project to learn how the game was created, make any changes you'd like, and then release your own version of the game. Just install Unreal Engine 4, download the Bridge of Dawn source code, and open the 'BridgeOfDawn_UEProj.uproject' file.

rows.name: GunsBox VR
rows.short_description: Have you ever shot a revolver? Now grab one, feel its coldness and weight, install a scope, and make a goddamn perfect shot. Learn how to use and customize different types of guns. Create levels and share them with the community. We've created this sandbox inspired by the popular VR titles for you.
rows.description_html: Have you ever shot a revolver? Now grab one, feel its coldness and weight, install a scope, and make a goddamn perfect shot. Learn how to use and customize different types of guns. Create your own levels and share them with the community. We've created this sandbox for you inspired by the popular VR titles. Playing this game, you will find out more about various guns, their features, and their design. You will get experience in shooting with optic and collimator scopes as well as using special grips and handguards. Your home location includes your personal shooting range. With “Remote Controller”, a special level-editing tool, you can create your own training configuration and level up your skill. For the first game mode, we've created IPSC based competition. You can compete across the globe in IPSC tournaments or create stages and share them with the community. More game modes and mechanics will be added soon. Stay tuned! Key Features: Realistic weapon physics - single and two-handed operation, center of mass (depends on installed accessories), weight, inertia Most frequently used weapon mechanics - semi-automatic, single action, double action, bolt action, pump action, revolvers Weapon accessories and tuning - scopes and sights (optic and collimator), handguards, grips, tactical flashlight, recoil compensators Weapons safety, feeding, and firing features - realistic and accurate implementation VR hands and custom gloves - all interactions have correct hand animations and pose selection Level editor - create your own levels, setup props interactions, share with the community and compete Tournaments and matches with global leaderboards under IPSC rules Designed for all popular VR headsets and controllers Smooth locomotion, snap turns and teleportation supported

rows.description_html: In Ibatic you can slide, wall run, wall jump and use your powers to create staffs that will allow you to jump great distances. rows.name: The Savior From Above
rows.short_description: A sidescrolling 3D adventure shortgame that combines multiple genres and features various action and puzzle sequences. Its artistic approach is supported by powerful visuals, intense atmosphere and a unique game narrative on the boundaries of science-fiction and fantasy.
rows.description_html: The Savior From Above is a sidescrolling 3D adventure shortgame that combines multiple genres and features various action and puzzle sequences. Its artistic approach is supported by powerful visuals, intense atmosphere and a unique game narrative on the boundaries of science-fiction and fantasy. An unnamed astronaut crashes his space capsule on an alien planet. As he explores the strange surroundings, he soon discovers that his arrival may not have been entirely accidental. According to the remains of an ancient local culture, he is believed to play a significant role in their history. The Savior From Above is a one-man project, a bitesize piece of handcrafted game art, the first release from its creator. The game is 100% free, but any financial support is highly appreciated. Please see the DLCs for donation options. Thank you and safe journeys!

rows.name: Friends of little Yus
rows.short_description: Friends of little Yus is a speedrunning game, race to the flag as fast as possible to reach the top. New rounds start every 14 days resetting the leaderboard meaning fresh chances for everyone!
rows.description_html: Friends of Little Yus is a speedrunning game, challenge your friends to get to the flag as fast as possible. But be aware, there are obstacles which would like to have a word with you. Find the quickest path and get yourself into the top 10. This singleplayer game is currently in alpha state, we will keep on developing and have big plans to add multiplayer support in the future. The current version of the game has a tournament system, every 14 days a new round will start with a random map. Each map has a different path, style and obstacles to keep the game interesting and fun. Every new round the leaderboard will be reset. Players can view scores using the built-in leaderboard system making it easy to track players and find about the times to beat (or hold).

rows.name: CYBERDAD
rows.short_description: Set in the year 2078, CYBERDAD is a 2D cyberpunk gunfight dungeon crawler following a disgruntled father seeking to rescue his daughter, and exact his revenge.
rows.description_html: Set in the year 2078, CYBERDAD is a 2D cyberpunk gunfight dungeon crawler following a disgruntled father seeking to rescue his daughter, and exact his revenge. You are a former employee of The Company, they have kidnapped your daughter, baiting your return. As you fight through floors of robots to rescue her, you will discover many things about The Company, and uncover the dark, sinister truth that they've been hiding for far too long. Slay different types of Roids, find and equip different types of weapons, and wreak havoc on The Company. Explore and Clear Floors - Four unique levels, complete with different enemies and challenges to overcome! Slay Robots - Fight through hordes of four different Roid types, all with unique abilities and weaknesses! Discover New Equipment and Weapons - Find and equip four different weapon types. Each has its own strength and weakness! Uncover Lore Documents - Piece together the story, and the truth behind the happenings at The Company, through old emails, files, and chat logs. Rescue Your Daughter - Fight to reach the deepest floor of The Company's facility, where the daughter can be found. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: DKLS
rows.short_description: In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality.
rows.description_html: You wake up. It's 6:00 a.m. You find yourself in what seems to be the room of a video games freak. There is no one else and there is no way out of the room. The only thing you remember is four letters: DKLS DKLS is a game that will make you reconsider the way of understanding video games. With a strong experimental and metaphysical sense, DKLS invites you to question the existing reality in a video game. In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. After playing for a few minutes on the DKLS machines, you will stop feeling your gamer physical reality and begin to feel the virtual reality of DKLS. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality. Discover DKLS and all that it offers to you.

rows.name: Rogue Planet 1
rows.short_description: Rogue Planet is a short action horror FPS game based on the Mayan Phenomenon of 2012. Made over the course of 3 years as my first game using GameGuru. A personal passion project.
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER: STEAM VERSION OF THE GAME MAY BE PRONE TO TECHNICAL ISSUES AND/OR MAY NOT WORK CORRECTLY. PLEASE REFER TO THE NEWS FOR NEWER VERSIONS OF THE GAME AND THE STEAM GUIDES FOR FIXES. THANK YOU FOR PLAYING. Rogue Planet is a short horror game about the Mayan Phenomenon of 2012. Made over the course of 3 years as my first big Steam game using GameGuru. STORY MODE: You are Markus Steelwyre: a soldier trapped in an endless cycle of misery in the Mayan Year of 2012. You are comatose after being seemingly shot in both arms, and the face. Yet you miraculously survive and find yourself in the events leading to that moment. The world is slowly ending, and you can't escape it. This is no dream. It's a nightmare! If you wish to survive, you must burn the memories to the ground if the real world is to continue, since a world without consequences can't exist and be happy, right? As you continue, the horrible truths of the dream become reality. The longer you stay, the more real they become. How can you know where you're going if you can't remember where you came from? And how far will you walk away from reality before you see where it leads? Wait where is everyone? Are you having deja vu or are you going in circles? And is she begging for you to end the world? Only you know what you're willing to sacrifice. The clock is ticking. Your destiny is nigh. FEATURES: 2-3 hour long story. 26 Levels. 10 Weapons. (4 Hidden Ones.) Colorful CRT-Style visuals. Music by the talented folks who volunteered their time and help. Various locations of a fantastical and war torn Santa Fe, New Mexico in multiple states of reality to explore. WARNING: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy or those sensitive to bright and flashing lights. Play at your own risk.

rows.name: Visite virtuelle de l'Assemblée nationale
rows.short_description: Visit the French National Assembly from home, using your computer, your Steam Deck, or your virtual reality headset.
rows.description_html: Visit the French National Assembly from home! Freely explore the National Assembly and the Hôtel de Lassay using your computer, Steam Deck, or virtual reality headset, in a fully immersive experience. A place of exceptional heritage and history Wander at your own pace through the iconic spaces of the National Assembly — the chamber, the library, the reception rooms, and the gardens — with smooth and intuitive navigation. Discover areas rarely open to the public, such as the Hôtel de Lassay, the official residence of the President of the National Assembly. An interactive tour Interact with artworks, paintings, and statues to access detailed information about each piece. Follow the guided tour in the chamber, or explore freely to learn more about the symbols, institutions, and heritage of the French Republic. A shared experience with friends Thanks to multiplayer mode, visit the National Assembly and the Hôtel de Lassay together, online or via local network. Enjoy a collective journey with friends or in a group.

rows.name: King of Kinks
rows.short_description: With a perfect balance of relaxing gameplay, engaging strategy and naughty fun, King of Kinks is a fun 5v5 squad RPG that is sure to become you newest guilty pleasure. Gather your harem and fight for the throne!
rows.description_html: Your father was a noble soul, yet a rebel at heart. He dared to challenge The Kingdom of Clouds, where formidable maidens ruled with an iron fist. These cruel mistresses weren’t just playing games; they dominated all men into submission. But your dear father, the Rebel King, wanted to change all of that. However, fate took a twist when he was executed. Now, with his legacy in your hands, you must dedicate your life to carrying out his wishes and fight the matriarchy! Embark on a quest to reclaim the throne of the Kingdom of Clouds while seducing every daring beauty in your path. In this whimsical world, meet stunning ladies, all fighting to win your heart and join your harem. And here’s another royal twist: rewards come effortlessly on an AFK basis. Play, rule your realm, take a break, and return to claim the rewards waiting for you. That’s a true noble treatment. Beyond steamy adventures, King of Kinks reigns as a captivating tactical RPG. With auto quick-speed combat and strategic elements, the gaming experience is going up to royal heights, worthy of a king's attention. Explore diverse game modes, join limited events, test your luck in the Gacha draw and enjoy lewd chats with your favorite girls. Choose from babes such as sexy ninjas, demons, queens, cat girls, elves, goddesses and build your invincible harem. Indulge in uncensored, hardcore hentai action with mind-blowing art and sexual content. Soon, you’ll dominate the kingdom and all its charming beauties!

In this whimsical world, meet stunning ladies, all fighting to win your heart and join your harem. And here’s another royal twist: rewards come effortlessly on an AFK basis. Play, rule your realm, take a break, and return to claim the rewards waiting for you. That’s a true noble treatment. Beyond steamy adventures, King of Kinks reigns as a captivating tactical RPG. With auto quick-speed combat and strategic elements, the gaming experience is going up to royal heights, worthy of a king's attention. Explore diverse game modes, join limited events, test your luck in the Gacha draw and enjoy lewd chats with your favorite girls. Choose from babes such as sexy ninjas, demons, queens, cat girls, elves, goddesses and build your invincible harem. Indulge in uncensored, hardcore hentai action with mind-blowing art and sexual content. Soon, you’ll dominate the kingdom and all its charming beauties!

rows.name: Impulse
rows.short_description: Picture a mash-up of Super Meat Boy and Lunar Lander. Or N+ meets Asteroids. That’s Impulse.
rows.description_html: Picture a mash-up of Super Meat Boy and Lunar Lander. Or N+ meets Asteroids. That’s Impulse. The premise is simple. You need to guide your craft to the exit point of each level, avoiding the various obstacles and bad guys. Levels are short, sometimes brutal affairs. There are no life limits, retry as many times as you need. Restarting a level is instant. There’s no waiting or loading — one moment you’re dead, a click of the mouse later and you’re ready to try again. You can even suicide so you don’t have to wait for death when you know you’ve fouled up. Your craft is at the whim of Newtonian physics. With only a simple thruster you need to battle the forces of gravity and atmospheric drag all while avoiding high-speed impact. The trouble is that all these variables are liable to change with each level. Gravity could be strong, or weak, or zero; it may pull in any direction. Drag might mirror the vacuum of space or the ocean depths. Your craft’s thrusters might be strong or weak. You might have limited or limitless fuel. Your hull might laugh off high-speed impacts or it might shatter from the slightest bump. With all these variables, levels take on very different feels. Some require careful thinking and gentle, deliberate action. Others are all about reflexes and reaction. Most are a mixture of both.

This is a game of a thousand deaths that keeps transforming itself.” Rock Paper Shotgun “It's a game that will make you shout 'balls to the universe' several times over.” Nerd³ “The game then itself becomes a grander tutorial, really, because you’re constantly learning and that’s a real compliment to a game that’s so minimal.” Video Attack!

rows.short_description: Everlife is a fast-paced maze game where you use mystical abilities to collect stars from several unique environments and escape them without being killed.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Everlife Classic Everlife is a fast-paced maze game where you must survive a mysterious realm that you have fallen into.  This version of the game is the original version, and it contains chapters 1 and 2. Collect the star and get out You are tasked with collecting stars from a variety of worlds, and returning safely. There are three different dimensions available, do you have what it takes to survive? Get running You are never safe in the dimensions. Dash at high speeds to the star, or to safety. Outmaneuver the monsters and make split second decisions to stay in one piece! Use abilities You are equipped with a special weapon. With it, you are granted special abilities. Use them to defend, deter, and escape danger. You'll start with only one ability, but you'll gain a new ability at the start of every level! Additional info For information on the current state of this game, please read 'Chapter 2 is now free-to-play + The future of Everlife'

rows.name: The Sink Gods
rows.short_description: The Sink Gods is a modern adventure game. You play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. When you are evicted from your home, you realise your only hope is the Sink Gods of the Great Basin. Journey to each of their temples, and pass their test to gain revenge for what you have lost.
rows.description_html: What is the Sink Gods? The Sink Gods is a modern point-n-click adventure where you play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. After you are evicted from your home, you must travel to the temples of The Sink Gods and complete their challenges to regain what you have lost... Art and Aesthetic The Sink Gods has a hand drawn cartoon art style, with frame by frame animation. The game uses vector graphics to reach an infinite resolution, so the game will look crystal clear on all devices. UI The Sink Gods utilises a simple and clean UI design that is easy to read. Use left, right, and down arrows on the edges of the screen to move around the various temples. Use the inventory on the right of the screen to inspect and use items you find! Gameplay And Puzzles To gain favour with The Sink Gods, you must solve the tests within their temples. Within the temples are many moderate/difficult puzzles for you to solve! Story and Atmosphere The Sink Gods is a funny game with unique humour that doesn’t take itself seriously. Language support The Sink Gods is officially supported in 3 languages: -English -Spanish -Kosraen (Kosraen translation is a little janky)

About the Game Play more of your favorite arcade hits from yesteryear. Includes SONSON for free! Capcom is taking you back to the stadium with another collection of your favorite classic hits! Come see what's changed, and what's completely new, in Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium! rows.name: Infinite Lagrange
rows.short_description: Different forces strive to make their own way in the space and desire the control of the Lagrange system- a gigantic transportation network. You, emerging as one of the force leaders, find yourself in a time of challenges and opportunities.
rows.description_html: We have extended our presence to one-third of the Milky Way with a gigantic transportation network—the Lagrange System. Different forces strike to make their own way in the world and desire the control of the Lagrange system. You, emerging as one of the force leaders, find yourself in a time of challenges and opportunities. Your fleet pioneers into the space unknown where war and sabotage may lie ahead. Are you determined to achieve something great out there or go back to the safety of home? From 0 to Infitnite Into the unknown galaxy, you have only a small city with two frigate. Through mining, building and trade, expand your base and territory, attain better ship-building technology and carry more weight in the intergalactic space. Customized Weapon System You may even modify and upgrade the weapon system on every single ship, if you ever want to tap into your creative side. It’s up to you to bring out the fleet’s full potential. Boundless Ship Combos Spore Fighter, Destroyer, Constantine the Great, Solar Whale Carrier...... With a myriad of ships and aircraft available, there’s really no saying about what kind of fleet you might put together with your unwearying ingenuity. Realistic Space Massive Battles In a space battle, a well-planned ambush can severely damage the enemy fleet. Or you can choose to guard thoroughfares with your fleet. A major battle could create a no-fly zone of hundreds of miles' radius. Venture Deep into Uncharted Space In a corner of the Milky Way, you will have your own base and view, beyond that is the vast unknown space. You will send your fleet to the dark frontiers where anything can happen. What else will you find other than stars? Interact with Interstellar Forces There are forces taking up parts of the universe. You can help them achieve their goals by sending ships to their aid, cooperate and prosper, or, instead, occupy their airspace and territory. There are countless unknown quests waiting for you. How would you choose? You Will Need Allies This is a dynamic society, where cooperation and conflict happen every day. Join or form alliance with global players. Expand territory and spread faith throughout the galaxy. You will enter a robust universe where you can strike for common prosperity with diplomacy or remain detached. It's thrilling to command the battle with a close view from all angles, and the 3D graphics rival any blockbusters. Only this time, you're the lead in the enchanting space.

rows.short_description: Help an old axolotl bring life back to a dying island in the Time on Frog Island Prologue - a small, self-contained, mini adventure and prelude to the full Trading Time game. Download the prologue for free and be sure to wishlist the full game if you enjoyed this first mini-adventure.
rows.description_html: Awakened from his daydream by a falling star crashing into a far-off island, the sailor changes his heading and sets off to investigate. After landing on the island, the sailor crosses paths with a shifty old shaman who steals their pet plant. Using cunning, guile and skill the sailor must aid the shaman with a mysterious ritual and help restore the island to its former glory. Only then can the treasured plant be returned and the sailor's journey recommenced. Fulfil the prophecy Make your own path in this island sandbox, you never know what will be around the next corner! Help the shaman restore the island to its former glory. Solve interesting puzzles to get your hands on required items. Run faster, jump higher, fall slower, anything is possible if you're holding the right item. Each object you pick up could end up being the key to something bigger.

rows.name: Momentum
rows.short_description: Fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style.
rows.description_html: Momentum is a fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style. Race against your friends in this easy to learn, hard to master couch pvp racing game, where you control your hover car around a gravity defying, twisting and turning racetrack. Use your hover car's grapple hook to swing yourself around corners at full speed, take shortcuts and make various other maneuvers. Just make sure you detach on time! For some extra speed, collect the various momentum charges found all over the track, to enable your boost to overtake your friends! Beat your friends at all of the three tracks in this game! This game was developed by 3rd years students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment Christina Fekkes Michael Bellekens Quinten Vanhooydonck Ruben Van Ostaeyen Silke Nemegeer

rows.description_html: Welcome to Capital Island This island has seen better days... now, they all wait hope knock on their door. You as a door-to-door seller will help Capital Island prosper again (while making some profit, of course!). Choose Your Hero To help you accomplish this mission, you'll have the company of Isla or Brody . That's no wrong choice here. Both are ready to make deals. Knock Knock Knock Each day you have to go door to door offering products from your catalog and making deals with the residents. Some will buy, some will offer a trade, some will ask for a donation... and others will just ignore you. But. nothing like a day after another, right? With your notebook, you keep track of your clients' requests and never get lost (since you have a map there too). Every morning your dealer's boat docks at the pier and you can shop to fulfill your customers' requests or sell when there are too many items (or too few coins). After that, just pack your bag and you're good to go! Let's Talk About Business When the island begins to evolve, new islanders will migrate and build new homes. And some will grab the opportunity to open their own businesses. That will also give you the possibility of different negotiations. And, who knows, maybe some interesting investments. Capital Island is waiting for you! Now, go knock on some doors...

rows.name: Haunted Hell House
rows.short_description: Horror action ADV to enjoy the fear.
rows.description_html: This game is a horror action ADV where you explore a creepy mansion. You avoid damaging gimmicks and clown and get keys as you go. Certain objects can be examined, and the perspective becomes first person. You can return to the title screen from the menu screen. You can use keyboard or XBOX360 and PS4 controller to control the game. Save the game automatically when you switch stages. Japanese and English are available, and you can switch between them on the title screen. The game can be made full-screen by pressing the F1 key. October 22, 2022 Episode 2 added.

rows.name: ITRP _ Gas Prison
rows.short_description: 10 minutes and you are free. Only 10 minutes and you will not be asked for anything else. Stay in these cells for 10 minutes and you don't have to come back here anymore. But at the same time, only one condition is required of you..... Be attentive.
rows.description_html: In fact, a short description of this game has deceived you. You will be required not only to be attentive, but also to react in a timely manner, to have intelligence and a good memory. ITRP _ Gas Prison will allow you to arrange a little test. You will find yourself in a system of cells, each of which can slam and poison you with gas. Keep an eye on the indicators to prevent this. However, the conditions under which you will be placed will not allow you to save all cells. Some will have to be sacrificed. And there are few useless ones among them: Some contain maps or timers. Some stores interactive monitors for system management. Some just has a lot of passages. The game is NOT designed to test your reflexes, reaction, accuracy or ...patience. It is designed to test your attentiveness, intelligence, ability to think ahead. Even if you need time to get used to and remember the location of the functional points, nevertheless, you will learn the detailed rules inside.

rows.name: Idiot Brain Evolution
rows.short_description: Welcome to evolve your brains, my lovely idiots. Seriously, this is a casual and entertaining multiplayer game, with a little brainstorming. Just have fun with others.
rows.description_html: This is a casual and entertaining multiplayer game, with a little brainstorming. Playing with friends will be lot of fun, but if you are a lone wolf, you can also play one of these games and have fun. Play the game. Win a PS5! For players who participate in the game, it is possible to get rewards. The current tentative reward is one PS5 per month. For more information, please see the announcement. Game Features: Different game types, including card game, answering game and interactive game. Play with friends, or match other players. Support 1-11 players. Hundreds of interesting questions, including images and videos. Enrich knowledge and exercise the brain while playing games. Creative workshop items. Multiple categories, hundreds of entries. Welcome to download and upload. More Joy In the Game, Waiting For You to Explore! Translations in different languages come from the Internet, please give feedback in time if you have any questions.

rows.name: Banzai Escape 2: Subterranean
rows.short_description: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean is a single-player or co-op anime 3rd-person action modern warfare shooter and a sequel based the events of Banzai Escape 2. You as a player, controlling a clone sister fighting to clearing up path inside the underground dungeon network.
rows.description_html: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean is a sequel game based on the events of Banzai Escape 2 where the Draugr labs have been captured by SPECTRE. All of the sisters (Inchester, Imingter and Iekler) take in refugees to a location deep underground. In order to survive, they must defeat the Lanun occupying the underground dungeon networks along with other factions such as SPECTRE and others You are an Elite Imingter agent with special access to roaming around underground networks to dispose any incoming threat. Lets Journey Underground Subterranean network Engaging Enemies Completing Missions Features: 1P or 2P Single-player / Co-op mode to allow friend to play together. Fun! Chaotic! Intense! Player will always be encountering action moment with rogue and aggressive like of enemies while finishing your objectives Customizable Customizable costumes / skins. Lots varieties of options to choose to make your character looks prettier. Random Generated Level Random generate map segments to allow different path taken toward objectives area inside underground dungeon RNG Arsenals Random generate gun & powerups or loot-able for grinding. Lots of guns and about 56++ nano-plugin addon powerups skills with lots of random stats that can be obtainable. ..And Many more!

rows.name: Time Idle RPG
rows.short_description: Idle RPG game that uses real life Time as the core mechanic and currency. Featuring offline progress, prestige, unfolding mechanics, trees, and much more!
rows.description_html: Wishlist my upcoming Steam game! Time Idle RPG is an idle incremental game with prestige and multiple layers of game mechanic unlocks. Each seconds that passes in real life is one second you can use in the multiple mechanics found in the game. As the game mechanics unfold, you will find yourself making decisions on how to assign the Time that you have gathered so far to optimize your gains. This game will gather Time and resources while not played. Featured Mechanics: 500+ Unlockable Sacred Timeline Tree Nodes (2) Layers of Prestige (Synchronization & Time Travel) Gathering Building Capturing Crafting Combat & Experience Equipment, Skill Runes, & Pets Passive Skill Tree Jobs Endless Tower Combat & Talents Derivatives Timers Raids Permanent Daily and Hourly rewards Cross platform save/loading (Steam + Android + iOS) Cross platform leaderboards (Steam + Android + iOS) Settings Tutorial Unfolding gameplay Steam achievement Local game achievements

rows.name: Babble Royale
rows.short_description: Babble Royale is an intense multiplayer free-for-all that combines word-making skill with fast-paced tactical and strategic action. Earn money and collect loot to upgrade your abilities, outrun the deadly hot zone, and outwit or outlast all your opponents to have the Last Word!
rows.description_html: Somewhere, deep in the Siberian wilderness, 26 letters play a deadly game of survival. Babble Royale is a game of high-speed, word-based combat. You are the last word you made. Eliminate an opponent by quickly connecting your word to theirs, before they do. 16 Players - 1 Winner Have the last word, or die trying. Stay Alive The deadly hot zone is creeping in from the edges of the map, forcing players together for the final showdown. Collect Loot From fallen enemies and power-ups scattered around the map. Level Up Earn money by making words. Spend money to get more letters faster, and acquire powerful items from the shop. Win Through raw word-making ability or by outwitting your opponents with clever tactics. Golden Royales ???? ??? ??? ? ??????? ???? ?? ??? ???? ? ?????? ?????? ????? ????? ??? ????? ?? ? ?????? ??????. Customize Express your inner Babbler. The store has a range of skins, hats, and emotes for you to earn or purchase. We made Babble Royale for competitive gamers who like smart games, and casual gamers who like intense competition. The combination of classic word-making gameplay with fast-paced tactical action means the game is easy to learn but has an insanely high skill ceiling. Season Zero is our early access launch. Over the next few months we look forward to expanding the game with new content and features and working with our player community to make the game as great as it can be. We hope you'll join us!

rows.name: The House Where They Dwell
rows.short_description: The House Where They Dwell is a first-person action thriller game from Half Brain Games, LLC. Play as the hosts of a popular ghost hunting show that is normally staged for views and discover for yourself the true horrors that dwell within this mysterious mansion.
rows.description_html: In this first-person action thriller, play as the hosts of a popular ghost hunting show that is normally staged for views as they discover that this house is truly filled with horrors. Explore a randomly generated mansion, find items to aid you, and kill the spiders infesting the area as you fight to escape The House Where They Dwell . EXPLORE THE MANSION Explore a randomly generated mansion as you collect items to aid you against the mysterious spider infestation! KILL SPIDERS Watch out! Spiders will increase in size until they are large enough to attack you. Shrink them back down with 'SpiderX' Spray and schmack them when they are small enough! DESTROY SPIDER NESTS Watch out for spider nests throughout the house, they seem to be where the spiders are coming from. Luckily, you can douse the nests and set them ablaze with 'Flickers' lighter fluid and matches!

rows.short_description: 2 clicks magic
rows.description_html: FAWE: Enchanted Forest - 2 clicks magic. Every evening, forest spirits gather in a glade to play FAWE. In this game, cards grant the power of natural elements. By collecting them all, the super element FAWE emerges, allowing players to enhance their skills. Spirits choose elements in the form of spheres, and engage in battles. Surviving spheres transform into spells, and the spirits begin to cast. To win, you must wisely choose both cards and opponents.

rows.name: Prosperous Universe
rows.short_description: In Prosperous Universe start your galactic empire by trading on the real-time market exchange with other real players. Build your 1st base from humble beginnings & watch as your business flourishes with complex supply chain strategies. Economics, politics & realism fuel this immersive business MMO.
rows.description_html: Choose Your Play Style Prosperous Universe offers several ways to play the game. The Free License is for new players and for those wanting a more leisure experience. The PRO License is for mid- to late-game players that want advanced gameplay options. The Basic License is activated once a player discontinues their PRO License. About the Game THE SPACE ECONOMY MMO In Prosperous Universe, you are the CEO of your own spacefaring company. Explore the galaxy, design spaceships, forge alliances, and most importantly: produce, trade, transport, and profit. Manage your business through a highly customizable user interface named APEX. Start your company at a slow pace as you accumulate wealth over real-time hours, and watch as all your hard work comes to fruition. Real Economics. Real Ramifications Contribute to a purely player-driven MMO economy in a persistent universe allowing for unique experiences, a multitude of play styles, and no grind to speak of. With its emphasis on realism in everything from the economy to space travel, Prosperous Universe provides a unique experience to players of all backgrounds. COLONIZATION From civilization building to workforce behavior, reality has guided the design for this space MMO. There are a wealth of factors to consider when deciding where to build your first base such as: atmosphere, minerals, temperature, pressure, access to water, and terrain. Understanding and exploiting complex systems are key to surviving in the vastness of the universe. Will you set up shop near the local commodity exchange or venture out to remote parts of the universe for more resources? The choice is yours. PRODUCTION No grind required: The success of your simulated business is not limited by the amount of time you input. Set your own goals and forge your own destiny in the deepest reaches of space. Every resource and commodity can and must be produced by a real player. Choose your profession wisely. Certain materials are easy to produce but won’t make you rich, while others are scarce but require careful planning. Stumble upon a goldmine-like supply chain and watch your profits skyrocket. TRADING Every price is determined by supply and demand in a real-time market exchange that operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This online space simulator provides an economy in which all players compete and cooperate with one another. Trade or bid on commodities, in-game currencies, and information with a vivid operational interface hub. Bringing wealth to your base will increase your workforce population, and over time your space colony will transform into economic force to be reckoned with. SHIPPING Transport cargo, design spaceships, or explore remote planets as you so desire. Spaceships provide players with a multitude of strategies. Will you establish multiple bases across the galaxy, ferrying materials to and from each location? Or maybe you would rather fulfill shipment contracts where you deliver resources to other players, for a price of course. Keep an eye on your fuel gauge, you don’t want to be caught on the intergalactic highway on empty. POLITICS Become the Governor of your planet and rule with an iron fist or a benevolent heart. Many planets are home to several political factions. These factions have their own interests and political agendas that may run in opposition to your personal or collective goals. Choose to join them or work against them. With enough leverage, you’re sure to be able to convince even the most powerful of politicians. Choose Your Play Style Prosperous Universe offers several ways to play the game. The Free License is for new players and for those wanting a more leisure experience. The PRO License is for mid- to late-game players that want advanced gameplay options. The Basic License is activated once a player discontinues their PRO License.

rows.name: Child of Lothian
rows.short_description: Child of Lothian is a historically-accurate 3rd person stealth-adventure game where you play as an Orphan who has been robbed of her childhood as her family is put to trial during the 18th century Witch Hunt trials. The game takes place in the old town of Edinburgh.
rows.description_html: The streets of 18th century Edinburgh disappear beneath the shadows of witch hunters looming in the streets. Hushed whispers appear in every corner and suspicious gazes of townspeople fall upon their neighbors, as friends become enemies. Among the townsfolk of Edinburgh, there is a young orphan called Katheryn. A helpful man, who she now regards as her new mentor, is teaching her crucial survival skills to evade the evil witch hunters and survive the streets of Edinburgh. Key Features Become Katheryn, a recently orphaned girl, who is accused of witch craft. Katheryn is learning how to use her sling and stealthily traverse in order to survive the streets of Edinburgh. Find pebbles and use your sling to create distractions or destroy objects. Evade the witch hunters by sneaking through the streets of Edinburgh and using the environment to your advantage. Sharing is caring, any valuables people carry on them are not safe from your pickpocketing. Scramble around the city to find loot or to get a better vantage point. Explore the winding, damp streets of the old town on your journey to survive the witch hunts. The town is full of secrets and characters to meet and interact with. Every problem has its own set of solutions and completing errands for the town-folk leads to different outcomes. Make your own choices and live to see the consequences. Explore a reimagining of 18th century Edinburgh. A bustling, living city. In an era of widespread fanaticism, witch hunters are roaming the city, searching everywhere for witches. These relentless zealots have accused, judged and executed your family. The witch hunters are onto you and will stop at nothing to hunt you down. A menacing force with an iron grip on the city. Don’t get caught! Witch hunters will use evidence you leave behind to find you and chase you throughout the world.

rows.name: Otherworld Legends
rows.short_description: A 'blood-pumping, face-bashing' roguelike brawler. Master heroes of your choice, craft uniquely broken builds, and hack & pummel through a myriad of dungeons in a thrilling rampage.
rows.description_html: About the Content Due to the harsh constraints of mobile app stores, we cannot support data transfer between Steam and mobile. Please refer to the FAQ for details. About the Game 'Fierce fighters from across time and space have been summoned to the Mirage created by Asura, where they are tested in a gauntlet of trials, while attempting to unravel the secrets that underlie this ever-shifting domain...' This game is a high-octane roguelike beat-'em-up where you'll get to – Explore exotic alternate worlds: From the grim medieval château to the frigid plains of Scandinavia, from exotic Persian deserts to the Forbidden Palace, the game's plethora of environments transports you to take on foes in historic arenas. Master powerful heroes with unique playstyles: A girl fulfilling her destiny to become a kungfu grandmaster, a ronin swordsman shrouded in mystery, an entrancing elf from Elfland... As additional merry misfits - each as delightfully bizarre as they are capable - are persuaded to join your motley crew within the Mirage, they become playable, with each bringing a unique skillset and playstyle to suit your adventures. Skill and item combos: Mix and match heroes' arsenal of skills with ability-enhancing item pickups found in levels to create all sorts of overpowered builds that can dish out devastating damage. Team up with your friends: Each run through Asura's Mirage offers a one-of-a-kind experience.

rows.name: The Van of Justice
rows.short_description: The van of justice is an action casual simulation game that contains many physical interaction elements. Knock all the students who bullied kim out. And it's also a good idea to show them around the police van of the police 'J'. At final, buy a nuke in kim's home and explode the entire school!
rows.description_html: The van of justice is an action, casual simulation game with a lot of physical features. Experience systematic ragdoll systems, thrown and broken objects, which are not obvious to be found in other games. 'You get revenge, I build results.' Police J comes to Kim, a student who was bullied at Turner High School in San Francisco, USA in 2005. J offers to give pocket money according to the value of the student's arrest if he punishes and arrests the students who bullied Kim. Kim, who was bullied by all students, accepted the offer, and now Tooner High School has only to be avenged. The way to realize justice All students at Tooner High School are bullying Kim. Punish by throwing weapons or physical objects. Revenge if you make eye contact while walking around the hallway. Punish even if the breathing sound is loud. Even if you're ugly, punish them. Punish both the teachers and the principal. If you take them to J's police van, J will pay an additional corresponding price. You don't have to feel guilty. Everyone is bullying Kim, and you are just realizing justice. If you lost interest in repeated punishment, it's not a bad idea to carry out additional quests provided by J . If enough money has been collected, the ultimate goal is to purchase nuclear weapons parts through Kim's home PC, expel all personnel in the school, and blast and demolish buildings . Slave of capital, student leaders The counselors (LMCD), as known as student leaders, will punish you when you do something wrong. Openworld games always has this kind of group. However, protection on students is not their jurisdiction. they only work for teachers and themselves. Is this a school or a subway entrance to hell? There are many unique friends in this school. Kim is also a very unique case right now. Coco Brothers , who throw up bombs when they're nervous, Jay and Jenny , a nuisance couple who always stick together at schools where dating is prohibited. Right, There are also a psychopath dancer rabbit Bunny and a 500kg giant Terence who destroys everything and everyone on his way.

rows.name: Red Triangle Super Collection
rows.short_description: Ten classic quirky games in one free collection! All proudly built using the OHR.RPG.CE.
rows.description_html: Red Triangle Games' collection of short OHR.RPG.CE games all in one place! Ten great games to start with more games added over time, all absolutely free. This bundle showcases not only Red Triangle Games but also several members of the Hamster Republic community, showing that with this little RPG engine, you can make just about anything. These titles are special to Red Triangle Games because they are made with dear friends and are some of the earliest titles that we've produced, revisited for this release. There's something for everyone in this collection! Scare Spree, a spooky romp around town where you try to unlock costumes and scare townspeople and monsters in three unique locations. Graffiti Goose, a mouse based puzzle game where you use your knowledge of mixing paints to get the high score. You'll have to act quick to reach the end. Video Goose, a short point-and-click adventure game with a quirky store about a video rental store owner who is down on his luck, and the misadventures of the goose he hires in his desperation for success. Missing You, a short arcade game where two hearts unite under a starry sky. You play as a falling star from one trying to reach the other. Knight Slights, a quirky play on a popular card game with mid-evil jokes and innuendos. Can you be the more terrible of the four knights and win the round? Block Bonanza, a battle puzzle game styled after classic match three style games with a ghastly cowboy twist. Fox in the Woods, a short arcade game where you try your best to make summer last as long as you possibly can by collecting falling leaves. Cthulhu's Paradox, an RPG where a monster learns self-reflection and decides what type of role they want to take in the world. Digibeasts, a single player v-pet designed for short and full sessions with lots of different beasts to try and acquire. Big Fish, a short arcade game where you try to eat as many fish your size or smaller to become the largest in the ocean.

rows.name: NeverRage
rows.short_description: NeverRage is a third-person online role-playing game, with action & tab-targeting combat that combines theme-park and open-world sandbox experiences. -Craft & Survive -Lobby The Chief -Expand The Castle's Influence
rows.description_html: Roadmap Kwaza Games - NEVERRARE 2025 ROAD MAP Report Bugs Here: We will fix any problem Be clear and detailed with the explanation of your issues. Support Url: Contact Support:  support@neverrage.atlassian.net - 2/2/2025 - 3/1/2025 First Co-Op event release - 3/1/2025 - 4/1/2025 Feedback and Maintainance  - 4/1/2025 - 5/1/2025 Weapon equipment test - 5/1/2025 - 6/1/2025 Web Update Mining Test - 6/1/2025 - 7/1/2025 Feedback and Maintainance - TBA About the Game -Under Delicate Development As of 2025 -Before you download or read any comment, ask yourself, Are you interested in the description of this game? If so, wait for it to be done...I will pay for advertisement, and announce in the  patch that the game is ready...Until then- You can only wait, so wishlist and wait. Contains Custom Cloud Ai Technologies: Valve requires this information to be announced publicly; as such: The NeverRage server contains Custom Cloud Artificial Intelligence Technologies. The client itself contains a traditional gaming AI system. Game and WebClient Merger: NeverRage is linked to a metaverse web project. It is not a Web3 project itself. Action and Tab-Targeting Interactions NeverRage combat consists of action and tab-targeting options for the two categories of players out there. In addition to that, it contains open-world exploration, crafting, building, political conflicts, campaigns, sieges, dungeons, and raids. Dev Speed/Resources Disclaimer: Since this is an indie passion project (by 1 developer) The workflow focuses primarily on programming instead of graphic design; Yep, NeverRage is going to be a low poly, low graphic, stylized role-playing game. This design decision will also allow the developer to focus on challenges (programming base content) such as: Real World Player Housing Simulated Randomly Generated Content to keep content fresh and rewarding for players. Arenas 0pen-World PVP (& Crime System - That would flag a player for PvP) Open World Boss Fights Trading Sailing The Game World Size: -NeverRage exists in one of 23 realms and is one of many potential Home Castles for Avatars. Each Landmass has 2 Castle Land Plots, which are divided by a battlefield. World Building Rules: We want players to see each other often. The Castles Do Not Go To War Unless Some Event SnowBalls and Eventually Trigger The Rage of A Castle Ruler. Newer Realms are only visible to Castle that have domination status in a neighboring Realm. Progression: Avatars will gain experience as their controlling player/device-user completes tasks and activities in NeverRage. Company-Wide Data Containment This data is persistent and will reflect the player's progress in the virtual reality we are designing (follow us on LinkedIn for tech news). Weapon Mastery System Intro Experience points will be granted to Avatars, to be spent on weapon mastery and to unlock higher level content. Social Class Progression Device Users can help their Avatar gain social class standing within their Home Castle by gaining Charisma through 1: Donating to guilds 2: Feeding NPCs that are in need 3: Resurrecting Players/NPC that were defeated while carrying out Castle commands (-Command/King's Order) 5: Romancing a higher-class member (NPC only - for now, until we put age safety in place with our virtual reality platform registration/verification feature) 6: Supporting Castle specific initiatives ...We will come up with other ways later. Exclusive Social Class Perks: Content Generation -Upgrade Activation (Based on your level, as a Cleric, for example, you may be able to boost the success rate of enhancement by 100%) -Family-Specific Trade Responsibilities (Paladins may be required to take on the responsibility of leading Crusades Sieges). -NPC recognition (AI is very important to us, and we plan on designing out virtual reality with AI that will adapt to Avatars as they change states -Ai might bow down to upper-class members of their home castle. Ai families might greet/invite-Avatars-to-launch allowing Users to choose to share in this experience) Weapon Mastery: Performing action relating to a weapon category grants experience which results in gaining points to be spent in the weapon mastery system. Points will be lost over time, or based on the players' Avatar actions. Crossplatform Crafting: To craft, players will have to gather materials and minerals from various places, things, and creatures found in the world of NeverRage. Aging System: Every item found in NeverRage has an Age factor, which provides information about how long the item can remain intact if it wasn't used or consumed. Arenas: 1v1 Duels and 1v1 Arena Matches can be negotiated 3V3 Matches Castle Battles & Politics: Based on the democratic decision of the upper-class NPCs and players of NeverRage, conflict can be carried out as a Siege, Infiltration, or Raid. Siege: A Massive Online Battle Arena event that may last from an hour to a week depending on the Ranks of the Castles. Infiltration/Stealth-Missions: During Sieges, and depending on the conflict mode decided by the politicians of both Castles, combatants will have to infiltrate and capture an Upper-Class Citizen of the opposing Castle. Raid: Without permission, a Castle's guild may be selected to Raid a neighboring Castle with little to no resources from their Ruler. Raids are unorthodox, and a failed raid may affect a guild's reputation in the world of NeverRage. PVE: ---Territory Battles: If a player defeats a pack of creatures, the player can duel and brand the champion of the pack. For the brand to be broken and reapplied, the contending player needs to defeat the creatures, defeat the pack's champion, and request a duel with the Avatar who previously branded the champion. Giants/Roaming and Stationary World Boss Competition: Guilds Competitions Guilds may challenge each other for a reward based on how fast and efficiently they can defeat an Emissary of the gods of NeverRage. Each guild will take turns, if it's an event, a Gladiator from each Guild will settle the competition, on-site, in a gladiator match. ---Hunts: Hunts are carried out by players who specialize in defeating as many packs of creatures as possible. As Avatars defeat packs, they gain the chance to acquire a 'Hunts Ticket.' The player who owns a Ticket will be allowed to invade the dwelling of a stronger version of the Creature/Emissary that their Avatar has been defeating. Be Patient All of these features and more will only be possible based on the developer's programming skills since art costs billions.

rows.name: Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars
rows.short_description: Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars is a free-to-play fast-paced multiplayer FPS, taking inspiration from games like DOOM and Quake. In Tannhäuser Wars, two unfamiliar groups are mysteriously teleported to the same location. Since communication between them is impossible or undesirable, they clash!
rows.description_html: Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars is a free-to-play fast-paced multiplayer FPS, taking inspiration from games like DOOM and Quake. Two unfamiliar groups are mysteriously teleported to the same location. Since communication between them is impossible or undesirable, they clash! Game Modes For now, there's a casual team deathmatch mode. In team deathmatch, each team starts with a set number of points, called tickets. Respawning consumes tickets from your team's ticket pool. When a team reaches 0 tickets and all its members are dead, that team loses. Note We're currently focused on increasing the player base. Sometimes it might be difficult to find game servers, but you can always join the Discord server and look for someone to play with. We have a matchmaking channel for that exact purpose.

rows.name: Ultimate Tag
rows.short_description: Gather your friends (or your enemies) and play Ultimate T.A.G. - A light-hearted, fun, callback to the game of everyone's childhood! With multiple game modes such as Classic, Infection, and Freeze Tag, endless hours of fun are guaranteed!
rows.description_html: Overview Tired of looking for a game for you and your friends to play that is not free? Want to run and jump around a wide variety of environments? Feeling the urge to replay your favorite childhood game? Look no further! Ultimate T.A.G. is a free-to-play game that can be played with up to 8 friends online! There are many game modes, ranging from the Classic one-person-is-it to Infection and much more! To show off your style, there are more than enough skins to tickle your fancy! Features: - Multiplayer! Play with up to 8 of your friends - Multiple Game Modes! Play a variety of game modes such as: Classic, Infection, Freeze tag, and more! - Customization! Customize your character with a variety of skins!

rows.name: Punk Wars: Prologue
rows.short_description: Our civilization has fallen. From the ashes, four new powers emerge. Immerse yourself in a combat-heavy twist on a classic turn-based 4X strategy where steam, steel, atom and diesel-punk corporations clash to spread their technology and the way of life.
rows.description_html: Our other strategy games: About the Game BUY THE FULL VERSION OF PUNK WARS: The years go by and another cycle has come to an end. Our civilisation has crumbled due to our greed and selfishness. Now we know that to avoid repeating the same mistakes, we need to stand united… and ours is the banner, under which humanity can thrive again. Our technology, philosophy and way of life are the ones that can finally bring happiness to the world… we just need to convince a few stubborn leaders... Punk Wars is a combat and tactics-oriented strategy drawing inspiration from the classic turn-based 4X titles. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, in which the ruins of a once powerful megacity become the arena for a deadly fight between four newly emerged corporations, trying to assert dominance for both their unique technology and philosophy of life. Punk Wars: Prologue will give you a taste of the full version of the game. Become the powerful leader of the Steampunk faction and defeat the Dieselpunk corporation before you run out of turns! Explore the ruins of a bygone civilization, where resources are scarce and the dangers way too common. Develop your infrastructure and technology that will secure your triumph. Create a winning strategy and a playstyle for your faction, utilising its own distinctive skills and units. IN PUNK WARS: PROLOGUE YOU WILL: Take control of the Steampunk corporation and use its unique skillset to lead your faction to glory! Explore the mysteries of a ruined, post-apocalyptic world! Level up your units and engage in fierce battles that will challenge your tactical sense! Grow your scientific, industrial and military infrastructure, creating advanced supply chains! Seek, garner and wisely use scarce resources!

rows.name: The Cruise 2
rows.short_description: Top down 2D sci-fi space themed roguelike bullet hell shooter with different player classes and abilities to play with.
rows.description_html: The Cruise 2 is a top down 2D space themed roguelike shooter where the players dodges hail storms of bullets while defeating enemies. Players can try out different player classes with different abilities and passives that can be customized to find new ways to eliminate the enemies. All sorts of different enemy types will also appear throughout the stages of the game, they all do different things and will need different tactics to defeat them. Different bosses will also spawn at the end of stages, it requires more skill to dodge the bosses' attacks. Allies will also spawn and help you take down some enemies, different allies will do different things, and will support you in different ways. The game is still being developed, so expect new content to come out once in a while.

rows.name: Karisvale
rows.short_description: Your next job awaits in Karisvale, detective. Will you fulfill your duty? Or become lost in the mystery... Explore a retro top-down world, question its citizens, and collect hidden items to uncover Karisvale's dark secret.
rows.description_html: Karisvale is a narrative-driven top-down mystery game where you assume the role of Shaymus O’Malley, a seasoned detective who has been summoned by the mayor of Karisvale to find a missing citizen. You must explore the town of Karisvale, question its citizens, and piece together what exactly is going on in this uncanny game. A Plethora of Interesting Characters, Each with Unique Motives Every citizen features branching dialogue paths that allow you to form your own conclusions in this gripping, cryptic narrative. Karisvale tells a non-linear story and it is up to you to piece it together. Unravel the Lore Through Collectibles Exploring Karisvale will net you hidden Dead Flowers that contain information on the history of where they were found. Find Dead Flowers in hidden rooms, through puzzles, and by talking to the townsfolk. I wonder what might happen if you collect them all... Additional Features A mesmerizing original soundtrack Authentic 2D art style with modernized twists Beautiful handcrafted locations to explore A short but condensed game, suitable for a single sitting Created mostly by one person, in the Unity engine, in the past year Inspirations include the Lavender Town creepypasta, Doki Doki Literature Club, and the film, Shutter Island Runs perfectly on Steam Deck!

Please uninstall this version and install the updated version at . The Michigan Transition To Independence (MITTIN) is a virtual life skills library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA). The topics covered in this game include: Safety and Independence in the Home Change a Light Bulb Clean the Bedroom Put Away Groceries Use a Microwave Use an Oven Use a Stove Safety and Independence in the Community Cross the Street Shop for Groceries Use Self-Checkout Walk Through a Parking Lot This game was formally titled, 'Special Education Modules'.

rows.name: Everglow
rows.short_description: Experience the story of Glow, a young and naive furry heroine caught between two empires' interplanetary ambitions, forged in tragedy and conspiracy.
rows.description_html: Everglow is a sci-fi visual novel about the space adventures of the fox Glow . Ten years ago, an incident occurred that sowed discord between the empires of Wolves and Foxes. But it doesn't matter to Glow , an ordinary and unremarkable employee of the research institute. Her days are devoted to shuffling papers around at work and talking with her beloved cactus at home. But soon, everything will change... How deep is the fox hole? Unravel a government conspiracy or become part of it. Discover all 5 unique endings. Be the fox you've always wanted to be.

rows.name: WavePlayer
rows.short_description: WavePlayer is a single player 2D pixelart wave survival game, the goal of the game is to defeat all of the enemies that spawn in intervals using a legendary Warrior and emerge victorious from the depths of the deep circling forests and caves.
rows.description_html: WavePlayer is a single player 2D pixelart wave survival game, the goal of the game is to defeat all of the enemies that spawn in intervals using a legendary Warrior and emerge victorious from the depths of the deep circling forests and caves. You can play as a mage with explosive energy blasts or a spirit archer of the wood, who's arrows can pierce through multiple monsters. Experience a beautiful 2D Pixel game as you battle jumping acidic slimes and angry flies who phase through the terrain. Winding lush forest with the sounds of an ancient past and elder trees looming over the sky sheltering the creatures below. An ancient cave with glowing mushrooms that paint a magenta film over the towering cavern columns. Learn to traverse the map, dodging enemies and surviving the waves using the environment to achieve victory. You're trapped by an unknown magical force in a looping world until you defeat all the enemies that stand in your way. You hear branches snap, something is coming your way. You prepare yourself to fight.

rows.name: Mi Scusi
rows.short_description: Mi Scusi is a casual adventure game following the exploits of the Scusi Man, an unstoppable force of Scusi causing chaos across the world...and beyond! Discover secrets and accomplish tasks in each level to unlock unqiue cosmetics and travel to new locations in this wacky world of Scusi.
rows.description_html: Mi Scusi is a casual adventure game following the exploits of the Scusi Man, an unstoppable force of Scusi causing chaos across the world...and beyond! Explore a multitude of levels, including the streets of New York, the waterways of Italy, and even inside the walls of the Pentagon, all in need of some Scusi-brand mayhem! In Mi Scusi, you play as the Scusi Man. Run, Jump, Grab, and Punch your way through obstacles (and Scusi people), using zany interactables and the environment to solve puzzles and tasks to obtain cosmetics and unlock the next level. Or, you can ignore these silly tasks, and look around for secrets or have fun with the objects, interactables, and NPCs in the world! Mi Scusi has 11 levels to explore and dozens of character customization options to explore and play with! Explore the levels to collect them all and experience the story of each level!

rows.name: Dot's Home
rows.short_description: DOT’S HOME is a single-player, 2D, narrative-driven video game that follows a young Black woman in Detroit living in her grandmother’s beloved home, as she travels through time to relive key moments in her family’s history where race, place, and home collide in difficult choices.
rows.description_html: DOT’S HOME is a single-player, 2D, narrative-driven video game that follows a young Black woman in Detroit living in her grandmother’s beloved home, as she travels through time to relive key moments in her family’s history where race, place, and home collide in difficult choices. As an interactive experience, DOT’S HOME allows players to see the harmful systems that dictate our relationship to race and place, through the eyes of those that are most impacted. By inserting the player into scenarios where they have to make choices about how and where to live in the midst of redlining, urban renewal, and gentrification, we ask a fundamental question: “How did your family end up where they are today, and how much choice did they really have in that journey?” DOT’S HOME is a production of the Rise-Home Stories project: a creative collaboration between multimedia storytellers and housing and land justice advocates who have come together over the course of three years, to reimagine the past, present, and future of our communities by transforming the stories we tell about them.
