rows.short_description: A new real time social deduction game, each players starts with a public Talent ( skill ) and a hidden independent Faction (winning condition), real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow.
rows.description_html: Game unsupported announcement Due to difficult in maintaining and revenue result, the game will stop receive updates or support from developers. Even so, everyone is welcome to try and play the game if they want. About the Game A new real time social deduction game, each players starts with a public Talent ( skill ) and a hidden independent Faction (winning condition) , real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow. Welcome to Hope Despair Chaos ! A game about Hope Cultivation programs and includes some of the Despair elements to stimulate the best outcome possiple. Join the program and may the fortune of luck let you be one among us, Symbols of Hope . Those remain evil will be chosen as Symbol of Despair , atempting to eliminate everything. Top Features: - When game starts, each player is given 1 Talent ( skill ), 1 Faction (winning condition) . They are independent meaning a Doctor can be Hope Doc or Despair Doc or Chaos Doc or any faction possiple. - Current talents list : Talentless, Plumber, Assassin, Engineer, Scout, Bartender, Doctor, Streamer, Lawyer, Fashion Model, Runner, Dreamer. - When you are killed, you leave an Encrypted Victim Message behind. - Crime scene investigation with flashlight, decrypting victim message and looking for the true murder location . - Real time shadow allow you to hide in shadow for real, as well as hiding a body . - Personal flash light with limit battery allow you to show off your management skill. - 5 cloth slot fully customiable for your fashion talents to shine. - You only need one copy of a cloth to wear it on your character in game. Feel free to trade or market your surplus cloths as you want. Most of cloths are tradable, marketable following Steam policy. Features: - Multiplayer real time casual assassinating and investigating game. - Playable from 1 to 10 players. - SPECIAL 2+ players game mode: : All player start as Symbol of Hope. Those first players to finish all tasks become Senior Symbol of Despair. - Each player start game with a unique talent benefit to all factions, ready to cook your master plan right from the begining. - Room host have extensive controls (see below). - Faction evidences scatter around the map, enjoy the treasures hunter experience, burn or share evidences just as plan. - 3D environment to show off your camera work. - Each room has their own light switch button , limit power hub to charge light. - Everyone can vote to return to waiting room safely , without remake a new room. - Player colors are fully customized , everyone can use a same color if need. - Voice chat . Factions: - Each player belongs to 1 faction when a game starts. There are special talents which CHANGES faction of a player. Symbols of Hope - The ultimate good faction . - Objective: Overthrow Symbols of Despair. Symbols of Despair - The lose at the end faction . - There are 2 rank: Senior, Ultimate. Each rank gives players additional talents. - Objective: Overthrow Symbols of Hope. Symbols of Chaos - The **** faction. - Objective: Get voted out. Chaos Slayer - The meme faction . - Objective: Personally slay exactly 1 member of each of faction: Hope, Despair, Chaos. Talents: - Host of a room can fully customize the talents pool, all assassins or all fashion models as you wish. - Host can config to play with Talentless pool, everyone has no talent . - Each player possesses 1 talent when a game starts. - Each talent gives players a way to be different, a chance to role play, a challenge to actually win. Talents list (update to newest version): - Talentless, Plumber, Assassin, Engineer, Scout, Bartender, Doctor, Streamer, Lawyer, Fashion Model, Runner, Dreamer. - Luck talent is not available and under research. Only Room host has these powers ! - Kick a player out of room, no question ask. - Make Entrance Test to filter compatible players against the host. - Config Force premade name to manage game environment. - Config Talents pool , all lawyers or all doctors as you wish. - Other features...

rows.name: Hotel on the Grate
rows.short_description: Hotel on the Grate is a short(15-20 min), narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients.
rows.description_html: Hotel on the Grate is a short, (like 15 to 20 minutes) narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients. Features Include: Meet and talk to interesting characters! Track progress with your Journal! Explore multiple locations! Diverse music! At least ten words of dialog! At least ten minutes of gameplay! Developed in the Godot engine

rows.name: Saboteur
rows.short_description: A Saboteur has infiltrated a science team on a space station, trying to bring it down. The Security forces must now find an eliminate him, without killing any innocent scientists, before the station goes critical.
rows.description_html: New 1 vs 4 Multiplayer Map Saboteur Must Deliver an Item Security Has Flashlights For the Darkness Saboteur Has Nightvision For the Darkness New Single Player Campaign! Begin your journey as the Saboteur on your mission of destruction. Play the first mission right now and the rest as they are released in the future. With new gameplay features expanding with each mission and all new interactions and cinematics for a better single player experience. New Gameplay Features Fully voiced dialogue system Quest objectives Cinematics New Single Player Mode: Sole Survivor! Do what it takes to survive the rage of rampaging aliens. Multiplayer: In a game of one versus up to six other players both teams need to use observational skills and planning to succeed. On the main map there are 12 objectives spread across three floors. You have 30 minutes. There are 6 Security Forces and the Saboteur only needs 6 objectives to win. Play too passive as Security and you lose. Play too aggressively as the Saboteur and you'll give yourself away. Security has to be careful though, kill a scientist and the Saboteur wins. Kill the Saboteur and you win. If the Saboteur can't get enough objectives in time Security wins. The Saboteur You have to achieve your objective of sabotaging enough critical areas while blending in with the AI controlled scientists. Don't draw any unwanted attention. Observe and mimic the scientists. You have several tools to your advantage, like the ability to sabotage lights and doors among others. With greater mobility you can outmanoeuvre Security Forces if you play smart. Security Forces Deduce the identity of the Saboteur by observing the scientists. Patrol and defend the critical stations from sabotage. Work together with the rest of the Security Force, communication is key.

rows.name: Urbek City Builder: Prologue
rows.short_description: Urbek City Builder: Prologue is a free city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures. Try it yourself for free!
rows.description_html: Urbek City Builder: Prologue is a free game where you will be able to build a city of your own design! Manage its natural resources, improve the quality of life of the population, and build its neighbourhoods in your own way. Neighbourhoods Breathe life into your city by building different neighbourhoods. Do you want a bohemian neighbourhood? Build bars, parks and libraries, but keep a low population density nearby. Do you want a bourgeois neighbourhood? You need parks and luxury shops. Manage There is no money in Urbek. Instead, you will have to build everything with your own resources, such as food, coal, or skilled work. There are more than 30 different resources to manage! Manage your natural resources well, so that they do not run out before they can be replaced. How will you choose to produce the energy for your inhabitants and industries? Educate Education is fundamental! By producing enough qualified work and scientific work, you will be able to build more advanced buildings. Observe Move around at street level in order to get a more intimate sense of the city you are creating. See and feel the differences between neighborhoods the way your city’s residents do! Organic growth The growth of your city will be organic. Some constructions will appear according to the surrounding conditions. For example, buildings with more than two floors will appear in densely populated areas and with basic services. You can place other buildings by yourself, but they need some conditions. For instance, the local market needs to be close to the farms. The university should have some high schools nearby, which, in turn, require nearby schools. When it comes to designing your city, you have a variety of viable options. There are no buildings that are superior to others. Every decision will have its pros and cons. Bourgeois houses consume more food and need resources that cost more to produce, but will improve the quality of life of the residents there. On the other hand, improving the productivity of industries will produce more resources, but will diminish the quality of life for residents living in the area.

rows.name: Car Manufacture: Prologue
rows.short_description: Build a car factory in the beginning of XX century. Discover new cars and technologies. Manage employees. Make tons of money and stay on top. Car Manufacture: Prologue, being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to try this automotive tycoon game.
rows.description_html: Check out the main game: About the Game CAR MANUFACTURE - PROLOGUE Car Manufacture: Prologue is a shortened version of a game about building and managing a car factory. This version of the game is limited to a tutorial, where you will produce your first car and learn the basic mechanics of production and sales. Additionally, there is one challenge mission, where you will need to use your wits to fulfill a special order for military vehicles. You start in the early 20th century with nothing but a few thousand dollars, which you will use to build your first manufacture. In time you will turn a simple workshop into an effective automatized factory. As you develop new car models and technologies, you will also have to manage your employees in the face of rising labor rights movements. Carefully build your brand’s reputation and promote your products to get ahead in the extremely competitive marketplace of the early automobile industry. Features Create a fully custom car factory. Build and optimize assembly lines for effective production. Manage several types of stats-driven employees. Promote products and set prices strategically. Develop new car models. Increase your factory’s popularity to draw more clients. Take part in industry events and face additional challenges. BUILD THE MOST ASTOUNDING AND FASTEST CARS! The beginning of the XX century brought us new opportunities. Show off the qualities of an excellent leader, as you will become the head of the car factory. It is up to you what will the future of the automotive industry look like. EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS! You will participate in the process of creating a car from the beginning to the end. Test manufactured cars as soon as they leave the production line. HIRE THE BEST OF THE BEST! Behind every car you create are people, more or less experienced. It is your responsibility to make the factory run at full capacity. Assign tasks accordingly to the skills of employees. AUTOMOTIVE INDUSTRY OF XX CENTURY AWAITS YOU! The development of the production line is the keystone. Start with individual stations to turn them later into a group of smaller, more-effective positions. Who knows, maybe in the future you will become a completely independent plant that produces even the smallest screw. STAY ON TOP In big business, it is easy to stay behind. Research new technologies and employ supervisors to ensure a top speed production.

rows.name: SPOOKWARE: Watch Party
rows.short_description: A collection of spooky microgames featuring fast-paced gameplay inspired by horror classics. Chop off legs, hurl hatchets, clash cards with Nosferatu, and many other ghoulish acts of terror! Features the original SPOOKWARE, SPOOKWARE @ the Video Store, and SPOOKWARE: Prologue for free!
rows.description_html: Before the school, before the cruise, before the restaurant. Experience the original version of SPOOKWARE, available for the first time on Steam. (For the uninitiated, SPOOKWARE is a blistering fast collection of handcrafted spooky games inspired by horror classics.) Watch Party is a completely FREE collection just in time for Halloween. We're going back to the past as we look towards the future of SPOOKWARE! SPOOKWARE: Watch Party collects: The original jam version of SPOOKWARE SPOOKWARE @ The Video Store from Dread X Collection 3 (previously paid!) SPOOKWARE: Prologue (FULL GAME DEMO) While you wait for the next installment of SPOOKWARE, settle in for: 40 spine-tingling, hair-raising, expectation-defying microgames. Witness the origins of our three favorite spooky boys: Lefti, Midi, and Righti. An experience that could cost upwards of 50 bones, but we're giving it away for FREE!

rows.name: Xenture
rows.short_description: Xenture is a short looter shooter game. Players need to destroy six hives located on the map then return to the spaceship to complete the game. We support multiple achievements for you to challenge.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Xenture. In this game, our hero is tasked with riding their neighboring planet of dark magic. Take down the 6 dark magic sources and discover secrets to unfold inside the world. Good luck, our people are counting on you! Bullet Hell Madness Defeat swarms of enemies located around the world creating chaos. Earn different movement abilities in order to help navigate hectic fights and take down all 6 hives found on the planet. Loot Loads of Guns In Xenture, there are up to XXX guns ranging from all sorts of types and rarities. Kill enemies and hives as well as locate secret chests around the world to collect them all! Different guns allow for new styles of play when traversing the world and completing the story! Player Upgrades As you progress, you choose how your player becomes stronger. Upgrade your choice of Health, Shield, or Ammunition Stock upon levelling up. Also, this unlocks the potential for better enemy drops as well. Once the player reaches different points of the world, they will unlock several movement abilities such as sliding, double jumping, dashing, and jetpacking. About Us We appreciate you taking the time to check out our game. We understand it has its flaws but our team is very proud of what we were able to create in the time span given. We are a team of 7 students from the University of Utah, who created this game for a class project over the course of 13 weeks of summer. We learned a lot from the creation of this game and really hope you enjoy playing it!

rows.name: Klaus Veen's Treason
rows.short_description: Treason is a 3-16 player party shooter of teamwork and betrayal, set among Italian mobsters. Use proximity voice chat, unique abilities/gadgets, and strategy to prove your innocence or deceive others.
rows.description_html: At the start of each round, players must uncover the Don's killer by finding Clues . Delivering enough Clues to the Clue Processing Unit reveals a Traitor . Traitors conspire against the Innocents , Detective , and Doctor . Traitors win by eliminating all Innocents , while Innocents win by identifying and eliminating the Traitors . Classes: Slim Class: Quick but weak. Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily HP: 80 Movement Speed: +10% Damage Bonus: Medium and Shotgun ammo deal 15% more damage Medium Class: Balanced. Heal - Restores 25 HP HP: 100 Damage Bonus: Medium and Sniper ammo deal 7% more damage Heavy Class: Slow but strong. Shield - Reduces incoming damage by 30% temporarily HP: 110 Damage Bonus: Light ammo deals 10% more damage Role Abilities & Gadgets: Innocent : Find Clues to snuff out Traitors. Class Ability - Varies by class Clue Locator - Shows positions of all active clues Doctor Locator - Shows position of the Doctor Detective Locator - Shows position of the Detective Traitor : Eliminate all Innocents. Class Ability - Varies by class Radar - Reveals player locations Revival - Resurrects a dead player Bomb - Plants explosive traps Silenced Pistol - Fires silent shots Spiked Bat - Delivers lethal melee strikes Disguise - Conceals your identity Bear Trap - Immobilizes players Poison Dart - Slows targeted players Detective : Scan bodies to confirm deaths publicly. Heal - Restores 25 HP Shield - Reduces incoming damage Detective Radar - Reveals player locations Doctor Resuscitation - Revives an unconscious Doctor Scanner - Identifies the killer of a body, or the planter of a bomb Stunning Taser - Stuns and disarms a player Doctor : Resuscitate unconscious players. Range Heal - Heals you and nearby players Range Adrenaline - Boosts your and nearby players' movement speed temporarily Resuscitation - Resuscitate an unconscious player Body Radar - Locates unconscious players Health Station - Allows players to restore HP Zombie Traitor : Help Traitors. Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily Radar - Reveals player locations Bomb - Plants explosive traps Zombie Don : Help Innocents. Heal - Restores 25 HP Shield - Reduces incoming damage Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily Clue Processing Unit (C.P.U.): At the start of each round, the Don's body appears. When a player discovers it, Clues spawn across the map for players to collect. Delivering enough Clues to the C.P.U. reveals a Traitor . Beware: Traitors can sabotage the C.P.U. by shutting off its power supply! Join our Discord community! Treason is a hobby project with a small but active and friendly community. Use the Discord server to look for players, if the game servers are empty.

rows.name: Kismet Tapestry
rows.short_description: A first-person, 2.5D singleplayer RPG set in space in the distant future, the player controls various members of the crew of the Federation of Frontier Colonies' Dirac Space Station as an intergalactic conspiracy unfolds.
rows.description_html: In this first-person, 2.5D singleplayer pixel-graphic turn based RPG set in the distant future, the player controls various members of the crew of the Federation of Frontier Colonies' Dirac Space Station, as an intergalactic conspiracy entangles its trusted captain. This game is mainly a story-rich Dungeon-crawler style RPG with cinematic cutscenes and sci-fi themes.

rows.name: Spirits of Carter Mansion
rows.short_description: Oh no! You've just kicked your favourite ball into the gigantic abandoned manor across the street! In a moment of bravery you venture inside to retrieve and journey around the house, uncovering its twisted halls, and sinister secrets whilst trying to escape with your beloved prize!
rows.description_html: Oh no! You've just kicked your favourite ball into the gigantic abandoned manor across the street! In a moment of bravery you venture inside to retrieve, but slowly begin to regret it. Journey around the house, uncovering its twisted halls, and sinister secrets whilst trying to escape with your beloved prize! Navigate each room of the house with your eyes open and watch your bravery diminish, or close your eyes and be safe, but lost wandering around the expansive corridors of the estate. Find yourself unlocking great secrets to the haunted house's past to help you navigate through safely! -Navigate using a classic North, East, South, West system akin to Zork -Explore several room with unique art as you bravely peek through your fingers; -Or instead close your eyes to wander around lost, but safely! -Uncover parts of the history of the Carter Mansion as you explore -Unlock different tool to help you navigate the house, including a nameable Cat companion that warns you of danger! -Lots of little secrets to discover as you try and complete all of the diary pages and unlock all the achievements!

rows.name: Crawlspace
rows.short_description: You've been tasked with crawling into a crawlspace to retrieve some dolls. what could go wrong? Made exclusively for VR
rows.description_html: You saw an Ad about someone needing help with an odd job, retrieving his daughters missing dolls. Sounding like easy cash, you leave a message telling him you are interested. but as the nights progress, you realize why nobody else wanted to take this job. ---- Main Objective - Collect and return each missing doll from the crawlspace over 5 nights using a unique VR crawling mechanic. Figure out how to stay safe from each doll with different attacks. Relax at your home and enjoy some TV. This game includes jumpscares. VR Only

rows.name: Stella's Spikey Dream
rows.short_description: Little girl, her stick and an adventure in a 2D card collecting action platformer!
rows.description_html: A relaxing casual game about a little girl, her big stick and their adventure to collect strange cards in a cave. This is a 2D action platformer game. The player needs to venture through a cave filled with dangerous spikes, and will be navigating through the levels to reach a mysterious enemy at the end. The core gameplay is platforming, the player will be utilising their ability to double jump in order to jump to and from multiple platforms. Timing is important as one wrong move and result in the player falling to their death. Some of the environment can be destroyed by attacking them with the stick carried by the player, maybe there will be interesting finds.

rows.name: No Crooks On Christmas
rows.short_description: No Crooks on Christmas is a tower defense game with a fun holiday theme. Defend your house against a relentless onslaught of crooks and save Christmas!
rows.description_html: ONE SNOWY, MAGICAL CHRISTMAS EVE... Your house is invaded by crooks! In this fast-paced tower defense game, you must defend the Christmas tree from a relentless onslaught of enemies. They're here to steal your presents, and they're not holding anything back. Spend star points to create Towers to defend your house. There are three Special Abilities you can use: the Bomb, the Water Bucket, and the Toilet. These abilities unlock as you progress through the different levels. The flaming presents will appear if the Christmas tree takes too much damage. The more presents you have active, the more damage over time your tree will take. Battle your way through ten different levels, then try your hand at Survival Mode! How long can you last against these Christmas crooks? * This was my first completed project as a game development student. * FEATURES: * Play through 10 different levels and a Survival Mode * Develop different strategies for Tower placement * Douse the fires with the Water Bucket when the presents are ablaze * Eliminate enemies quickly with the Bomb and Toilet abilities * Fun and quirky holiday theme CONTROLS: * Space Bar: Move between the different rooms of the house * Left Mouse Button: Click to place Towers and use Special Abilities

rows.name: Soma Union
rows.short_description: Having fallen to a great calamity a second time, it's up to Zero and their friends to put Soma back together! What is on your horizon is for you to decide...
rows.description_html: We spirits are curious things, Zero. We all have a purpose to fulfill, and each of us represents something. And I hope you can figure out what you represent, too. Guess you can figure that out while you're off putting the whole world back together. Soma Union is a galaxy-spanning adventure that returns to the world of Soma! ...or so it would, if your planet had not been destroyed in a great calamity. As you roam through the cosmos to find the missing fragments of your home world, you'll meet a colorful cast of characters and make important choices that may not be as clear as they seem. Soma Union is an SNES-styled RPG that aims to celebrate the classics (and the not-so-classics because they deserve love, too). As you experience this space-faring story, you'll explore vast dungeons, interact with strange characters, fight riveting turn-based battles and discover the fate of a shattered land! Combat is all about synergy and supporting one another! The Role System changes your characters' roles in battle: Fight your enemies with the damage-dealing Power role, or enhance other party members' abilities with the Support role! By utilizing roles to your advantage, you'll be able to achieve great effects that a single party member can't accomplish alone! Embark on a galaxy-spanning quest to put your home world back together again, because this planet can't seem to catch a break, apparently. Unleash powerful Spirit abilities regardless of your current role to turn the tide of battle! Collect valuable Power Gems to skip enemy encounters with the push of a button... or tough it out and exchange them for rare prizes! Fully custom visuals. And a stellar soundtrack by SpecialAgentApe 10+ hours of good ol' son-of-a-gun RPG gameplay. Funny jokes. The heehees and the hawhaws.

rows.name: Porcelana
rows.short_description: Isabella, your classmate, is someone you were never close to but someone you certainly noticed. One day however, you notice that Isabella stopped coming to class. You start to discover how important you were to her despite never even having a conversation with her before.
rows.description_html: Join our Discord! About the Game Synopsis Porcelana ( Porcelain ) is a story of a girl who is perceived to be perfect by society but is actually more normal than others may think. This shows a reflection of reality where people wear masks to hide the darkness in their hearts. Although the story itself was written years back, we are wanting to share it with others in a new way through a visual novel format. We hope that this emotional story will touch your heart and be one that you remember. If you could change the past, would you? Isabella, your classmate, is someone you were never close to but someone you certainly noticed. One day however, you notice that Isabella stopped coming to class. You start to discover how important you were to her despite never even having a conversation with her before. She has left you notes in a particular way that takes you on a journey where you discover her past and meet the people who were important in her life. Be careful with what choices you make as they can impact the events and direction of the story. Isabella She was so pretty, with her beauty being indescribable. Her flawless smile was like staring at the clouds. She was the correct path among thousands of wrongs. She was always herself, not perfect, but the image of perfection. She was someone that you looked up to the most. Despite always seeming so delighted and happy though, you already realize just how miserable she was, even to the point where she was contemplating cutting ties to life and choosing death as her final escape. Camil You met Camil because Isabella left her a note too. You don't know too much about her just the fact that she is your classmate too. Maybe she has some beauty hidden under those cap and glasses. Dallen She is Caroline's mom. Dallen's work usually puts her at risk and that is why her greatest fear is that one day something could happen to her leaving her daughter alone. She is a loving mother and a very smart woman. Caroline She's the reflection of the purest innocence. She is a happy child even though she hasn't lived a perfect life, because she has lived hard moments in her short life. She has a fantastic imagination, which often results in her losing herself in her own dreams.

rows.name: Eldritch Lands: The Witch Queen's Eternal War
rows.short_description: Dive into a dark fantasy world and fight against the endless undead horde. Unlock, upgrade and deploy units in a simple to understand yet engaging strategy gameplay loop. Grow plants that grant exp bonuses and converse with each unit to learn more about their character and backstory.
rows.description_html: Eldritch Lands: The Witch Queen's Eternal War is a dark fantasy strategy game in which you play as the titular Witch Queen in her struggle against the endless undead horde. In this bleak world where all the gods have either been killed or abandoned their people, when the dead rise due to the sudden appearance of a Necromancer known only as the Necroshroom Queen, it’s up to the Witch Queen to defend her Kingdom. As normal humans only add to the undead army when they die, the Witch Queen diverted all her resources into creating an army of fake people, known as a Homunculi, to serve as an unending fodder to hold the dead at bay. Unlock, Upgrade and Get to Know Your Units Discover up to 12 different units that you can use in battle. Each with different ups and downs in combat, you can customize your team to better fit your playstyle. Prefer slow moving but heavy hitting units? Or quick and long ranged? Build the team that best suits your needs. Each unit is also their own individual character, and the more you upgrade a unit the more conversations you unlock as well. Get to know each unit and find out their outlook on the war, their life or what it means to be just a copy of a copy of the memories of someone long dead. Farm Resources and Read Lore During battle, you can gain seeds that grow into fruits and plants that are highly concentrated in essence, the currency that all of the Witch Queen’s magic relies on. Plant those seeds and harvest them after they grow for a great boost in essence. You can also read through the lore of the world to gain more knowledge of what happened before and why the world is in such disarray, and a new entry is added with each new enemy and item you encounter throughout your playthrough.

rows.name: Fantasteroids
rows.short_description: Fast-paced gameplay, rainbow colours and snappy animations all come together to give you a retro arcade-feel game with renewed graphics and avatars. There's a variety of different modes for you to choose from, and different skins to unlock and leaderboards for you to show off to your friends!
rows.description_html: Enjoy a refreshing arcade-like blast to the past with Fantasteroids. A game with a simple concept, which is easy to pick up but hard to master. You will need incredible precision, an unblinking eye to watch for hazards, and a stamina to match a marathon runner's. Features Fast-paced gameplay A variety of different modes and experiences for you to choose from Over 20 different characters and skins to unlock Steam leaderboards so you can play and compete with people around the world!

rows.name: Phantom-OS
rows.short_description: Phantom-OS is a physics-infused strategic hacking simulator where you will put your skills and wits to the test.
rows.description_html: Phantom-OS is a physics-infused strategic hacking simulator where you will put your skills and wits to the test. You play as Kyle Hastings, a capable programmer with a knack for hacking. Having dropped out of college to focus on your newfound passion, you now live a double life: a freelancer by day and a gray hat hacker by night. But little does Kyle know, his life is about to take a major turn when he installs a strange operating system: Phantom OS. UNRESTRICTED ACCESS (NO SCRIPTED LIMITATIONS) A core philosophy of ours is a “no scripted” approach to player actions. You can (eventually, given your skill as a hacker) gain full control over every device in your network, delete, break (as in physically, with a hammer) any computer you can get your hands on. WINDOW-BASED OPERATING SYSTEM A familiar concept to almost everyone, your computer behaves like - what else? A real computer. Run programs, create, move, and delete files organically, and given the special arsenal of tools at your disposal, infiltrate into other machines to steal data, brick devices, or spy on your targets. FULLY SIMULATED NETWORKS Every computer, from those you target to the ones you own, are fully featured internet-connected devices, able to communicate and transfer files between one another. This happens via in-world routers and relays making up the network. PHYSICS BASED ENVIRONMENT Your computers, like your environment, are real in-world objects. You can move, interact with, and modify them for your own needs. Make your hacker den your own. EMERGENT GAMEPLAY The way you tackle missions depends on your approach. Go in person and attempt to get physical access to your target. Remotely from your secured network Social engineering FACTIONS As you make a name for yourself, you will discover that you are not alone. Multiple other hacker groups will notice your actions and either take a liking for it or attempt to shut it down. Balance your influence with social opinion on your actions, maintaining a delicate balance to not risk detection. LIVE YOUR LIFE The world waits for no one, not even you. Opportunities come and go and it's your job to make the most of them. The game features a full day/night cycle with events and opportunities becoming available during certain times of day, so plan and manage your personal life and schedule accordingly. Your surroundings affect you as much as you can affect them. Learn your town and its networks, opportunities, and exploit them to achieve your goals - be it fame, money, or connections. BEYOND/HOPEFUL Given the early-access state of the game and our very small team (2), we plan to continue working towards achieving our final vision for the game, past the stuff mentioned above. This will include: MILESTONE 1 Procedurally generated hacking opportunities (events, scheduled PC uptime, rival hackers' actions, etc.) Currency, inventory management, upgrade systems Leaving the apartment - outside city content: locations and activities MILESTONE 2 Multiplayer V1 (hacking only - players can help each other from their apartments) Adding roleplay elements (NPC interactions) Game balancing Modding support MILESTONE 3 Expanding roleplay elements (reputation system, branching story) Diversification of missions, quality of life Improvements More content (larger city, more missions) Multiplayer V2 (fully featured coop and group missions)

rows.name: Virtual Aquarium - Overlay Desktop Game
rows.short_description: A relaxing game displayed as an overlay above system windows. Can't you have an aquarium? Now you can - on your monitor!
rows.description_html: OTHER GAME! OUR NEWEST GAME! If you already have any DLC, the rest that you do not have are also in the -20% promotion! About the Game Do you love fish and have your own aquarium but it is not enough for you? Or maybe you can't have an aquarium and would you like to? This is the perfect hit on your part! Virtual Aquarium: Overlay Desktop Game is the game for you! This game works as an overlay above all windows - so you don't have to distract yourself from the current activity to watch your fish look, grow and get wonderful colors. Main features of the game: The game is displayed as an overlay above the windows. Everything happens no matter what you are doing. Your beautiful and colorful fish will swim on your screen and make your time spent in front of the computer at work, school or at home more pleasant. Interaction with fish By clicking on a fish you can check its name and species. Many species of fish There are over 20 species and over 100 subspecies of freshwater and saltwater fish in the game. Beautiful colors and fish patterns The fish in our game have wonderful vivid colors, as the fish grows its colors become more vivid and more expressive, thanks to which your virtual aquarium allows you to beautify your screen even better. Graphic effects The game has various graphic effects that will introduce you to the world of your own aquarium even better. Additional functions AUTO START - Your aquarium will automatically greet you when you turn on the computer. GAME MODE - the game will go into hibernation when you start another game in full screen, which will ensure full computer power. With the help of keyboard shortcuts, you can easily operate the basic elements of the game.

rows.name: Protect The Treasure
rows.short_description: In a distant future, humanity left Earth and many creatures were left behind. You have to survive in this dangerous world and protect the last treasure left by humans.
rows.description_html: Humanity changed everything. After all the chaos, they left the planet, leaving droids and changed creatures behind. You got the last treasure on Earth. Changed creatures are after the treasure that is in your hands. They will do everything to get it. Protect at all cost! Game in first person. Control a placed cannon and defeat the enemies that comes your way. Use mouse to control the cannon. Left click to shoot. Right click to pass the texts.

rows.name: Vortle
rows.short_description: Vortle offers safe, healing, and soothing spaces to play games, meditate or breathe. Vortle's games come with Compassionate AI to Support Positive Mental Health.
rows.description_html: Vortle offers safe, healing, and soothing spaces to play games, meditate or breathe. Vortle's games come with Compassionate AI to Support Positive Mental Health. We work on the intersection of video games and applied artificial intelligence - all to provide inclusive, accessible, and positive experiences to people on their mental health journey. We are on a mission to bring Vortle to every device on the planet, and positively impact people's mental health across the globe. Designed by neurodiverse gamers, artists, AI scientists, and the mental health community to achieve state-of-the-art efficacy, accessibility, and inclusion. Evidence-based and community certified.

rows.name: Zeitgeist
rows.short_description: Equipped with your pot plant companion, travel through the roots of time delving into the past and present depths of an ancient submerged city. Exploring grand halls, navigating between walls, and taking advantage of ancient mechanisms on your mission to steal the heart of the city.
rows.description_html: Drain the past Legend tells that deep within the endless desert lies the dry remnants of an ancient submerged city said to hold a source of endless water - The heart of the City. Playing as the Submariner, you will fight past the city's defences, navigating its labyrinth of halls and mechanisms in order to reach the heart. Two worlds Water is all but extinct in the world of the Submariner - Join forces with the remnants of nature with the aid of your newfound pot plant companion in a heist to steal from a past civilization drowning in wealth. Explore a submerged city filled with life and mystery in both its past and present form; encounter all manner of wonders and dangers as you overcome the challenges of your descent and the true nature of the city is revealed. Explore the ancient submerged city both in the past and the present Jump, run and avoid hazards as you descend further into the city. Solve puzzles taking advantage of the city's ancient mechanisms and your time switching abilities

rows.name: The Timeless Child - Prologue
rows.short_description: The Timeless Child is a 2-player puzzle-adventure coop game with first-person view. Embark on a journey, through time and space, to save Emily Wells from her endless temporal jail.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game The Timeless Child is a 2-player puzzle-adventure coop game with first-person view. Start an exciting and engaging adventure, a tale about family, bonds and secrets. You will explore Wells Manor, an ancient 16th century villa full of history and secrets, living the experience from two different temporal perspectives . Whether you decide to take on the role of Chris Hunt , a skilled hunter on call, or Emily Wells , a child trapped in the past, you'll need to collaborate with your partner to solve puzzles that require cooperation and logic to be completed. Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey to the borders of time and space to save Emily from her time captivity? TIME PROJECTION Emily is in the same space as Chris but at a different time in the past. Every action of Emily in the past will reflect on Chris's world in the present. UNIQUE WORLDS Unique elements within the game world depending on the chosen character. Live the experience from two different points of view and discover the consequences caused by the flow of time on the surrounding world. SKILLS 5 different puzzles, each characterized by a unique design and a different solution approach. You will need a full bouquet of skills to finish the game with your partner. Get ready to test your exploratory and descriptive ability, coordination, logic and reflexes. If you think you are good at solving puzzles, you should challenge yourself with this game. LORE Wells Manor is rich of lore and secrets just waiting to be discovered. In this Prologue you can start to understand all the story behind Emily's broken fate. Who and why trapped Emily in the past? FEATURE LIST 2-player cooperative puzzle game with first person view 3D graphic with realistic style Original, immersive and compelling music and sounds

rows.name: Boring Movies
rows.short_description: Challenge your friends to identify famous movies based on your most boring possible description of the plot! Can you stump them or are your friends actual true cinema fanatics that can name Citizen Kane from the most minute detail?
rows.description_html: Think you’re a movie buff? Boring Movies dares you to prove it... with a twist! Get ready to turn the most exciting films into the most yawn-worthy descriptions and challenge your friends to guess which cinematic masterpiece you're describing - without putting them to sleep! How it Works: Gather up to 3 friends, choose a movie, and describe it in the most mundane, painfully dull way you can. Can they see through your boring disguise, or will your “thrilling” description of “Guy goes on a walk and drops a ring in a fire” stump them? Can you name what movies are being described? Guy finds a ring and his nephew returns it to the factory. Old lady tells a story about a boat on a different boat. Man turns off alarm clock 3176 times. Whether you’re the kind of friend who calls The Matrix “a guy does VR” or describes Jaws as “big fish causes beach problems,” Boring Movies is your chance to take movie nights to the next level of hilarity. Think you’re up for the challenge? Unleash your inner boremaster and let the guessing games begin!

rows.name: Crow Story
rows.short_description: Jump, dive, and platform through this minimalistic indie 3D platformer about a little crow trying to save his friends.
rows.description_html: Jump, dive, fly, and platform as the cute little crow, Kuroh, as he goes on a quest to save his friends. Progress through a series of levels in this 3D platformer to reach the top of the tower and discover the mysteries of the Celestial Owl and the fate of Kuroh's friends. Pure Platforming Utilize a simple two-button control scheme to Jump and Dive in order to navigate platforming obstacles and puzzles. Use platforming elements such as moving platforms, jump pads, and spinning disks to find new and creative ways to navigate the world. Each level features new obstacles to hinder you and mechanics to challenge you. Find shortcuts using tricks such as B Hopping and momentum to master the environment as you progress. Be warned - the journey to the top will not be easy. Though checkpoints and fast respawns will keep you going, each section requires precise movement and quick thinking. A Minimal Adventure Uncover the story of Crow Story through a minimalist-style narrative with no dialogue or spoken words. Features List 8 beautiful levels Boss fight Several unlockable skins Story sequence cutscenes Platforming-based obstacles and challenges Totally intended shortcuts for you to find

rows.name: PlanetDrop - A Tiny Space Adventure
rows.short_description: PlanetDrop - A Tiny Space Adventure is a computer game where you command a spaceship in an orbit of a planet. Your primary task is to capture 'drop zones' with your shuttles and commandos. You rely on stealth, agility and speed, rather than on firepower.
rows.description_html: PlanetDrop - A Tiny Space Adventure is a computer game where you command a spaceship in an orbit of a planet. Your primary task is to capture 'drop zones' with your shuttles and commandos. You rely on stealth, agility and speed, rather than on firepower. Game mechanics and features The mechanics are described in their best details on the official game website, but here are some of the most distinguished: - the ships feel like in real space - no gravity, inertia - planets have atmosphere - ship might get damaged by it - full 3d movement freedom - patience, some tactical thinking and battlefield observation is needed - automatic weaponry, countermeasures - armor and shield for most of the ships - ship subsystems, repairs - story progression, described in briefings before every mission - briefing hints and in-game tooltips to act as tutorial and help the player - friendly, neutral, enemy ships - small random events Ship/inventory management There is a basic inventory management with option to replenish it at certain conditions - when approaching space station or calling for support. The ship uses fuel and life-support items. Overall feeling Inspired by 'The Expanse' series, the set is (trying) staying 'close-to-real-world' physics and limitations, where space is vast, empty and dangerous, the humans are vulnerable, sustained entirely by their craft. The technological level, with small exceptions, is close to our near-future one. The short background story can be found on 'the set' subpage on the website. Game Length: The game is about 2-10 hours long, includes 6 single-player missions. The difficulty level is moderate. Creation This is an independent, non-commercial, non-profit project, driven by the pure passion for games, the curiosity how they are made and function, the admiration of the ingenuity it takes to create one, the huge challenge and a long-lasting dream. The game is created in the span of 10 months - from January 2021 to October 2021, by a single man with no experience in the field whatsoever.

Completely FREE no strings attached We love our community and want it to grow, so we've decided to release Void Maker completely FREE !

rows.name: After Dark VR
rows.short_description: After Dark VR is a VR online co-op survival horror where you play as either a Hunter on the hunt to strike down your next victim or as Survivors working together to stay alive and escape.
rows.description_html: A FIRST EVER VR ASYMMETRICAL HORROR GAME: NEW: Play with A.I. bots! In order to ensure anyone can play with a full lobby and experience the full game at any time, we are proud to announce that after a lot of hard work we have added A.I. bots After Dark VR is the first VR online co-op survival horror where you play as either a Hunter on the hunt to strike down your next victim or as Survivors working together to stay alive and escape. 6 Hunters in 6 Maps are Available Now with many more to come! - Immersive VR Horror Experience - High Quality Maps - In-Game Chat - A.I. Bots Objective for the Hunter is to use brute force striking down the Survivors locking them away in a Cage so they can't escape. Objective for Survivors is to turn on 4 Fuse Boxes so the Exit Gate powers on allowing them out of the area they're trapped in with the Hunter. Fuse Boxes are located all around the Map. Survivors need to find a Fuse Box and turn all levers from OFF to ON then power on with Handle. If done incorrectly, the levers will reset. Light will switch from Red to Green once powered on. Note: The Hunter can interact with the Fuse Boxes and reset progress made. Once Survivors power on 4 Fuse Boxes they can escape through the Exit Gate and win. When the Hunter strikes down a Survivor the Survivor enters Spectate Mode and their body spawns in a Cage somewhere in the Map. Survivors can free teammates by pulling the lever beside the Cage the Survivor is trapped in. The Hunter must strike down all Survivors to win. Suburbs Prison Hangar Farm Police Station NEW Highschool MORE COMING SOON (2022) 4 friends are renting a house near a Music Festival for a weekend getaway where there just so happens to be a ruthless Hunter on the loose. After trying to leave, they quickly realize the Hunter has turned off the exit's power, leaving them trapped until they figure out how to power on their escape! The developers describe the content as: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Frequent Violence or Blood, General Mature Content

rows.name: SPY RUMBLE
rows.short_description: Kill the spy who has blended in! Up to 8 players battle royale imposter
rows.description_html: Update Notes 2023/04/22 New item 'Killer Badge' and third camp 'Killer'. 2023/02/21 New map 'Secret Lab' has been implemented. 2022/08/27 New mode 'Hunting' was implemented 2022/08/27 Zombie Pirates Shima skin was implemented 2022/07/03 Text chat feature implemented 2022/06/25 Open Room Match function implemented About the Game Welcome to the crazy battle royale imposter stage! Among the agents gathered on this stage, you will find a spy who is plotting to assassinate you. If you find a spy, you must either put a lead ball from your gun in his head or persuade the others to expel him. Of course, be aware that your own back is always being watched. If you're just scared, you're easy prey! If you don't want to get yourself killed, you can have fun killing the spies that have slipped through the cracks! Number of players: 4-8 This game is an identity concealment style, in which the player is divided into two cliques, the agent team and the spy team, and take action to achieve the respective victory conditions. Available for multiple players with voice chat function in-game. (Using voice chat is recommended). -Agents-. The agents are imposed to transfer the coins they have earned, fill up the helicopter with fuel and escape, or find and get rid of the spies who are hiding in the team. If you see anyone suspicious, call a meeting! -Spies- The mission of the spies is to eliminate all the agents. To achieve this, pretending to be an agent, obtain and use the items and weapons from the spy armoury or use the spy gadgets that you equip with you for the mission. Spy gadgets are secret weapons dedicated for spies that can be equipped in for the mission. You can use it as many times as you want by purchasing it in the store. Transceiver can be purchased at the store, that can host a meeting to start discussion. You can get a player to expulsion at the meeting, by voting someone you think is suspicious. One player, one vote. Third camp -Killer- Agents can change into the third camp Killer by meeting certain conditions and purchasing the “Killer Badge”, an item that becomes available in the store. The Killer's goal is to eliminate all players except himself, and once he becomes a Killer, he will be able to use the Spy Shop. Hunting Mode Hunting Mode is a more combat-oriented mode than the regular game mode. The victory condition is quite simple: victory is achieved by annihilating the enemy camp! Spies have fewer people and can use exclusive weapons and skills. Agents win not only by defeating their opponents, but also by escaping from the helicopter by transferring coins. Voice chat is available for all allied teams regardless of distance, so you can work together to hunt down the enemy team!

rows.name: THE SPRITE TRIALS
rows.short_description: THE SPRITE TRIALS is a speedrunning platformer with a nice selection of upsetting level design, confusing visuals, and life-ruining replayability. Meditation is recommended before and after playing. Based on the original WebGL version.

rows.name: SOLAR CAGE
rows.short_description: You have one job: BLOW UP THE SUN. A game perfect for parkour/shooter fans, speedrunners, and those looking for an extra challenging experience!
rows.description_html: “SOLAR CAGE” is a challenging parkour-shooter that takes place in the distant future, where a majority of humanity has been converted into mechanical monstrosities. They’ve built a Dyson sphere surrounding the Sun, using its energy to fuel their highly inefficient lifestyle. Using something known as the CATALYST, their consciousness exists as a copy of their original brain within these bodies. You play as JANITOR-2828, a designated cleaning robot who is suddenly contacted by an unknown entity. Your abilities are upgraded from cleaning to being able to jump, wall run, and slide with ease. It was even nice enough to give you a signature rail gun. All of these achieve a simple task: BLOW UP THE SUN. RUN. SHOOT. REPEAT. Pull off crazy acrobatics as you run, slide, and jump around each area in the facility. One bullet, one chance. If you miss, you'll have to beat down robotic combatants to reload your gun. Make every shot count. Chain your parkour and combat skills together to pull off epic, precisely timed traversal combos! HELLO WORLD Shoot and jump your way through 9 dystopian levels that never fail to test your timing, accuracy, and willpower. Experience new mechanics as you get closer to the Sun, from gravity flipping to challenge arenas! Discover a multitude of paths in each level to figure out the quickest routes for speedruns. PREPARE TO DIE No checkpoints, no easy mode, no excuses. A hero's journey is never that simple. Master each level to the point where you know every shot, wall run, and leap of faith like the back of your hand. Then, impress your friends with perfect runs! Do what it takes to BLOW UP THE SUN!

rows.name: Endless Battlefield
rows.short_description: Endless Battlefield is a competitive multiplayer online FPS game. It gives players the capacity to control various weapons and vehicles in the game.The FPS covers 6 modes: Conquest, Capture the Flag, Rush, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch and Kill Confirmed.
rows.description_html: Discover and experience FPS battles in an endless battlefield world! FPS includes 6 modes: Conquer, Capture the Flag, Sprint, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch and Confirmed Kill. The following is the content of subsequent development in the future, and will be marked: The planet metaworld mode is rich in content to meet the needs of different players. The game supports intensive FPS/TPS, allowing competitive players to enjoy the experience of galloping on the battlefield and conquering military points. Metaverse also creates a stress-free and immersive environment for casual players, allowing them to harvest, mine, wood, fish, hunt, and craft items. In order to create a rich and interesting meta-world, EB has also introduced a unique alliance system, construction system, home system and trading system. The official version will cover the complete FPS/TPS combat content. Planets metaverse content will be accessible through the DLC version.

rows.name: 戦国の木こり
rows.short_description: 'War era Lumberjack' is a mini-game in the process of making a simulation game during the Warring States period in Japan.
rows.description_html: 'War era Lumberjack' is a mini-game in the process of making a simulation game during the Warring States period in Japan. This is a game in which you have a lumberjack cut down trees and compete for how much wood you can collect within a certain period of time. Players can only order which trees to cut.

rows.name: Doge Dimensions
rows.short_description: Blast through the Doge Dimensions and explore the multiverse in this open world adventure. Fly, dash, and defy gravity as you discover unknown terrain and take on a variety of challenges.
rows.description_html: Explore The Galaxy: Take advantage of Doge’s robust movement options to explore 3 far-off planets, and take on unique challenges Gooba's Gambit Fight hoards of Gooba’s in a grueling gauntlet to the death. Collect their eyeballs and be wary of their Slime Slinging Slashes Coin Chase Collect as many coins as possible while navigating a forest of crystals and evading perilous sandstorms Hidden Hams Look through every crack and crevice as you explore the sacred Hidden Ham Hills to satisfy your hungry Doge.

rows.name: Lost Light
rows.short_description: Join the 'Firefly' task force and unveil the sinister plot behind the exclusion zone in the world of Lost Light. You could either scavenge for supplies or go out with guns blazing and plunder. Survive the brutal domain where danger lurks in every corner!
rows.description_html: Join our Discord! About the Game Easy to play! Both FPP and TPP are here for you to choose from. Realistic warfare survival Factories, harbors, forests...... these once familiar sights have been desecrated by the wrath of the apocalypse. Never neglect small details on the battlefield or there will be fatal consequences. You must know your weapons and know your equipment, explore every corner of the battlefield, learn to effectively deal with hunger and pain, and make tactical plans...... Complete survivors' commissions, scavenge for supplies, and hone your skills to survive the exclusion zone. Authentic Firearm Customization From structures to textures, the firearms in the game are meticulously recreated to provide players with the most realistic firearms experience. Each firearm supports up to 12 modifiable parts and hundreds of components to choose from. It's time to optimize your loadout from hundreds of possibilities. Of course, the system will also provide several recommended loadouts for Quick Equip. All About Tactics In Lost Light, violence is not always the answer—as long as you can find the evacuation point, you can make it out alive. You may choose to go armed to the teeth, wreaking havoc and reaping the loots, or you may choose to be a minimalist, scavenging your way to a small fortune. But remember, if you die in combat, you lose everything—the loots are not yours until you make it out alive! Map Out Before Moving Out Prepare yourself for battle in your shelter. Not only do you need to boost your body energy and stay in good shape, but more importantly, you have to customize and build your own loadout. But be careful with the gear you choose, because the battle begins when you start to equip yourself. Diversified Social Interaction Unlike conventional competitive survival games, Lost Light allows you to choose partnership over being a lone wolf. You may decide to team up with a spared enemy or commission other players to rescue you after you're knocked out—endless possibilities await! Profit Off Free-trade After the evacuation, you retreat deep within the abandoned subway tunnels where you stash your loot and establish a foothold. After upgrading it to a full-fledged base of operations, you can set up shop and trade within Lost Light's player-driven economy. Sell your surplus and buy what's in need—Trade wisely and your chance of survival increases! Cross-Platform Play PC gamers can now feel the exhilaration of battle. Players on mobile devices and PC will be able to chat with one another for a cross-platform gaming experience. Form parties across the different platforms to complete more challenges and achieve the impossible!

rows.name: Live Adventure
rows.short_description: Throw yourself into an exciting adventure! Live Adventure is a 2nd person game where you follow the journey of two young explorers, Lence and Reel in search of their parents. Solve the mysteries of a lost civilization while exploring a lush forest littered with mysterious ruins.
rows.description_html: Live Adventure is a 2nd person adventure game that follows the expedition of a unique sibling duo of young explorers wannabes. The brother, Lence, holds the game camera, and the sister, Reel, is filmed by that same camera. The adventure starts at the launch of STEVE, the camera of Lence. After the disappearance of their parents, those siblings throw themselves on a great adventure to find them back. Working together, on the track of a lost civilization, they will discover wonderful places and uncover mysterious ruins. As a player, you have constant control over these two characters. You will have to use their abilities in synergy to explore and solve puzzles in the lost ruins of a lush forest. Experience a completely new way of controlling two characters with a gamepad from the point of view of a camera hold by one of them. You will be able to really play as a duo! Follow the story of Lence and Reel, on an expedition to find their missing parents. Follow them in their journey full of mysteries, adventures, and emotions. Lence and Reel will travel through many colorful extraordinary places, discover an uncharted forest full of exotic vegetation and enigmatic ruins. During their expedition, Lence and Reel will discover many ruins and old mechanisms that they will have to understand to solve the mysteries of a legendary civilization and find their parents.
